title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Assistente de pesquisa
description:
Assistente de Pesquisa – Ciências Regulatórias (Campo)


Este profissional será responsável por apoiar a condução de ensaios regulatórios de campo com cana-de-açúcar, realizando atividades de plantio, avaliações, coleta e registro de dados experimentais. Atuará garantindo a qualidade, rastreabilidade e organização das informações necessárias para a elaboração e submissão do dossiê regulatório, conforme os prazos do pipeline de biotecnologia.


Principais rotinas e responsabilidades

  • Conduzir ensaios de biotecnologia em campo (LPMAs), incluindo plantio, avaliações agronômicas e colheita de eventos transgênicos, conforme protocolos experimentais.
  • Executar ensaios em condições controladas (estufa e laboratório), seguindo normas de biossegurança para OGM.
  • Preparar kits de coleta, planos de estudo e livros de campo, garantindo organização e disponibilidade de materiais para ensaios.
  • Registrar métodos, materiais, equipamentos e resultados em planilhas, formulários e sistemas, assegurando rastreabilidade e integridade dos dados experimentais.
  • Apoiar o time de Supply Chain no monitoramento das entregas e qualidade do material coletado em campo para ensaios regulatórios.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de protocolos agronômicos e regulatórios aplicáveis aos ensaios com cana-de-açúcar geneticamente modificada.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares envolvidas no pipeline de biotecnologia.


Formação

  • Graduação em Agronomia ou Biologia.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência com manejo agronômico de culturas (cana-de-açúcar ou milho).
  • Experiência com experimentação em campo envolvendo OGM.
  • Conhecimento de manejo agronômico e condução de ensaios agrícolas.
  • Carteira de habilitação válida e disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Conhecimento intermediário com Pacote Office (Excel / Word / Power Point)


Desejáveis

  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas operacionais (SAP e/ou LIMS).
  • Experiência prévia em ensaios regulatórios ou biossegurança aplicada a OGM.


Competências comportamentais esperadas

  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade a atividades de campo.
  • Disposição para aprendizado técnico contínuo.
  • Resiliência e organização em rotinas experimentais.
  • Perfil analítico.


Somos uma empresa para todos: Respeitamos, incluímos e valorizamos.

title: Content and Social Media Marketing, and Graphic Design Intern
description:
Calling All Awesome Marketing Interns!!!


Are you eager to learn and gain hands-on experience in Social Media Marketing, Content Marketing, and Graphic Design ? We’re looking for a motivated apprentice to join our team and help us create engaging content that connects with our audience.


The program is a 3-month remote internship , during which you will assist in fulfilling various digital marketing tasks for your mentioned business for 10 hours per week. This is an unpaid program whose end goal is to provide students with a higher chance of getting hired in the digital marketing space after completing our apprenticeship program.


What’s In It For You?

  • It’s (100%) fully remote position and offers flexibility in schedule.
  • You’ll have clear goals and the training resources you need to deliver.
  • Access our free courses on the platform that you can finish at your own pace.
  • 1 to 2 hours of mentorship every week.
  • Issued certification upon successfully completing the program.
  • Boost your portfolio and grow your professional network
  • Get to utilize and elevate your digital marketing skills in real projects
  • You have a high chance of being hired by your mentor during or after the apprenticeship, depending on your performance.


What You’ll Do:

  • Assist in creating engaging content for social media, blogs, newsletters, and campaigns
  • Support the design team with graphics, layouts, and visual assets
  • Help manage social media platforms and support community engagement
  • Contribute to PR initiatives, including drafting press releases and coordinating with media partners
  • Brainstorm fresh ideas for brand awareness and digital campaigns
  • Support administrative and marketing tasks as needed


What We’re Looking For:

  • Background or strong interest in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, PR, or related fields
  • Basic knowledge of content writing and social media strategy
  • Skills in graphic design tools (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar)
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Creative mindset with a keen eye for detail
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines


About us:

Acadium started with the belief that anyone, anywhere, should be able to get the skills and experience they need to start their career without barriers like price, schedule, or location getting in their way. Acadium gives anyone the tools, support, and mentorship they need to launch their dream career. Acadium is the only platform that provides real work experience, accessible to everyone. Acadium began in 2017 with a team of 3 co-founders: Richard Shaw, Marco Tundo, and Moe Abbas. Since then, they’ve attracted more than 120,000 student members and over 50,000 businesses to connect through the apprenticeship marketplace. Our team is growing and looking for people who are motivated, intelligent, and committed to making education accessible to join our team.


What We Value:

  • Integrity - Be trustworthy in your actions
  • Care - Treat your teammates and our community as you would want to be treated
  • Curiosity - Ask questions. Always state your assumptions
  • Tenacity - Persevere when times are tough
  • Discipline - Be consistent in your actions
  • Ambition - Aspire to become better every day
  • Service -Serve your community to the best of your abilities.

title: CONSULTOR DE VENDAS
description:
Vagas Disponíveis para Regiões: Sul, Sudeste, Centro Oeste, Norte, Nordeste


Sobre a Vaga

O profissional será responsável por realizar a gestão de vendas de nosso portfólio de produtos, através dos canais de vendas, identificando e desenvolvendo novas oportunidades de negócios.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar a gestão de vendas de nosso portfólio de produtos, através dos canais de vendas.
  • Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócios.
  • Apresentar as características técnicas e benefícios dos produtos aos clientes.
  • Realizar visitas regulares a clientes e potenciais clientes.
  • Participar das feiras e eventos do setor para promover nossa linha de produtos.
  • Registrar as informações de negociações, vendas e visitas em sistema CRM.
  • Participar de reuniões periódicas com gestores e diretores.
  • Esclarecer as dúvidas dos clientes sobre os produtos realizando suporte técnico.
  • Participar das demonstrações de produtos e treinamentos a clientes.
  • Monitorar as atividades da concorrência e adaptar estratégias, se necessário.
  • Manter a interação com as demais áreas da empresa com a finalidade de explorar novas estratégias e oportunidades.


Qualificações

  • Desejável ensino superior em Agronomia, formado ou cursando.


Habilidades Necessárias

  • Experiência prévia em vendas técnicas ou consultivas, com foco em máquinas e implementos agrícolas.
  • Residir na região de atuação.
  • Flexibilidade de horários e disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.
  • CNH categoria B.


Habilidades Preferenciais

  • Vendas consultivas, proatividade, orientação para resultados, visão de futuro, persuasão e influência.

Vagas Disponíveis para Regiões: Sul, Sudeste, Centro Oeste, Norte, Nordeste


Sobre a Vaga

O profissional será responsável por realizar a gestão de vendas de nosso portfólio de produtos, através dos canais de vendas, identificando e desenvolvendo novas oportunidades de negócios.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar a gestão de vendas de nosso portfólio de produtos, através dos canais de vendas.
  • Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócios.
  • Apresentar as características técnicas e benefícios dos produtos aos clientes.
  • Realizar visitas regulares a clientes e potenciais clientes.
  • Participar das feiras e eventos do setor para promover nossa linha de produtos.
  • Registrar as informações de negociações, vendas e visitas em sistema CRM.
  • Participar de reuniões periódicas com gestores e diretores.
  • Esclarecer as dúvidas dos clientes sobre os produtos realizando suporte técnico.
  • Participar das demonstrações de produtos e treinamentos a clientes.
  • Monitorar as atividades da concorrência e adaptar estratégias, se necessário.
  • Manter a interação com as demais áreas da empresa com a finalidade de explorar novas estratégias e oportunidades.


Qualificações

  • Desejável ensino superior em Agronomia, formado ou cursando.


Habilidades Necessárias

  • Experiência prévia em vendas técnicas ou consultivas, com foco em máquinas e implementos agrícolas.
  • Residir na região de atuação.
  • Flexibilidade de horários e disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.
  • CNH categoria B.


Habilidades Preferenciais

  • Vendas consultivas, proatividade, orientação para resultados, visão de futuro, persuasão e influência.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic & Video Content Designer

We are building a fast-growing brand in the health and wellness industry and are seeking a strategic, creative, and performance-driven Graphic & Video Content Designer.

This is a key position within the company, with direct impact on sales performance, brand positioning, and overall growth. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, can manage a high volume of projects, and enjoy taking creative ownership, this opportunity is for you.

Responsibilities

• Create high-impact graphic and video content for paid ads, social media, email marketing, website, and online marketplaces

• Develop creative concepts aligned with marketing strategy and conversion objectives

• Produce short-form videos optimized for TikTok, Instagram, Meta Ads, and Amazon

• Prepare and finalize print-ready files for production, ensuring proper bleed, safety margins, color profiles, and print specifications

• Develop technical files for packaging, labels, and promotional materials

• Conduct quality control checks before production

• Maintain brand consistency across all platforms

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines with strong organization and attention to detail

Requirements

• Minimum of 3 years of proven experience in Graphic Design and/or Video Editing

• Hands-on experience preparing print-ready files and packaging materials

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite

• Proven experience with CorelDRAW

• Strong understanding of color profiles, CMYK, RGB, resolution, and print production standards

• Strong portfolio showcasing real projects, preferably performance-driven and e-commerce focused

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

• High level of organization and attention to detail

Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred, but portfolio quality and proven experience carry greater weight.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to grow within a fast-expanding brand

• Dynamic and challenging work environment

• Strategic projects with direct business impact

• Competitive compensation based on experience

Application Requirements

Mandatory: Please include a portfolio link showcasing both graphic and video projects. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

In addition, please include your expected monthly compensation for the services to be provided.

title: Gerente Nacional de Vendas – Injetoras
description:
Gerente Nacional de Vendas – Injetoras


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Mínimo 5 anos de experiência como Gerente de Vendas de máquinas industriais, preferivelmente de injetoras
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipe comercial
  • Carteira ativa de clientes
  • Histórico consistente de crescimento com manutenção de margem
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar o crescimento nacional da unidade de injetoras
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver equipe de representantes
  • Viajar constantemente e atuar em campo com a equipe
  • Participar diretamente de negociações e fechamentos
  • Realizar reuniões estratégicas presenciais na sede (mínimo 2x por mês)
  • Organizar workshops internos e com clientes
  • Garantir cumprimento rigoroso dos processos estruturados de venda


Não buscamos gestor que venda focado apenas por preço ou condição de pagamento.

Buscamos liderança que construa valor para o cliente, defenda margem e conduza vendas complexas com método, focado em resultado e margens.


Modelo PJ com remuneração variável agressiva conforme desempenho.

description:

Wall Street Oasis (WSO) | Mentorship Program

3,000+ Mentors | 1+ Million Students | Global Reach


Our top mentors earn $50K–$100K+/year , some even earn $3K in a single week (if you qualify to become a head mentor inside WSO Academy) ... work from anywhere, any timezone


Wall Street Oasis (WSO) is expanding its Mentorship Program, and we're looking for outstanding professionals to join our mentor roster... an elite network supporting students and young professionals as they prepare for high-stakes careers.


What You’ll Do:

  • 1-on-1 Coaching: Provide personalized mock interviews, resume critiques, and career advice
  • Cohort Guidance (Optional): Lead small groups through structured prep sessions, especially around IB and PE recruiting cycles
  • Contribute to Content (Optional): Help enhance financial modeling & interview prep standards and improve student-facing materials
  • Mentor With Purpose: Share real-world insight and high-quality feedback to help mentees thrive


Who We’re Looking For:

  • Professionals with experience in Investment Banking (or similar PE, HF, S&T, etc)
  • Current or former Analysts, Associates, VPs, Principals, or Engagement Managers
  • Strong communicators with a passion for helping others succeed
  • Detail-oriented and consistent in providing thoughtful, actionable advice


Why Join?

  • Remote & Flexible: Contribute from anywhere, on your own time
  • Credibility: Be part of one of the most respected finance communities globally
  • Impact: Help shape the careers of students from top schools, as well as students who come from diverse backgrounds
  • Low time commitment: Coach just a few hours a month... or more, if you're interested

title: Desenvolvedor lowcode
description:
O que procuramos:

Profissionais com experiência em desenvolvimento lowcode utilizando Oracle/Apex

Desejável experiência com a linguagem JAVA (spring)

Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e boas práticas de desenvolvimento


Requisitos e qualificações:

Curso superior completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou formação de nível superior em qualquer área de conhecimento, com pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia da Informação com duração mínima de 360 horas;

Conhecimento em linguagem Oracle PL/SQL; Experiência sólida em Oracle APEX; Banco de dados Oracle 19c ou superior

Modelagem de dados; Linguagem SQL; Consumo de APIs REST; Controle de versões com GIT; Conhecimento de Javascript, HTML e CSS; ORDS para criação de APIs; Criação de relatórios interativos, formulários, dashboards e processos automatizados

Desenvolvimento e manutenção de objetos de banco (procedures, functions, packages, triggers); Implementação de validações, autenticação, autorização e controle de acesso; Manipulação de objetos JSON; Implantação de aplicações em diferentes ambientes

Diferenciais:

Oracle APEX versão 24+; Remote Deployment; Scrum; Conhecimentos em Angular; Conhecimentos em Java; Implementação de CI/CD e processos de automação

title: Systems Engineer (Data Compression)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


***

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Systems Engineer with deep experience in compression algorithms and high-performance systems.

You will work closely with the core engineering team to help analyze, validate, optimize, and productionize advanced lossless compression technology .

The ideal candidate is both technically rigorous and intellectually curious , capable of investigating unconventional approaches while applying strong systems engineering discipline.


What you'll work on

  • Designing and optimizing lossless compression techniques
  • Evaluating compression performance across different datasets
  • Improving throughput, compression ratio, and memory efficiency
  • Benchmarking and profiling performance-critical systems
  • Building high-performance libraries and services
  • Collaborating with engineers to productionize compression technology

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, C, or other systems languages
  • Experience with performance optimization and profiling
  • Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures
  • Experience building high-performance systems or infrastructure
  • Comfortable working with confidential technology under NDA
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

Nice to have

  • Experience with compression algorithms (LZ, Zstd, Huffman, Brotli, etc.)
  • Background in storage systems, distributed systems, or databases
  • Experience working at cloud providers or infrastructure companies
  • Experience with benchmarking or systems performance testing
  • Familiarity with AI / GenAI development tools


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil (remote)

Contract: PJ (long-term)

We’re looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to join our Inbound team and build highly scalable machine learning solutions that power item attribute detection (e.g., color, material, style) and merchandise authenticity verification.

If you’re passionate about solving real-world business problems using state-of-the-art Computer Vision and ML techniques — and enjoy taking ownership from research to production — we’d love to connect.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve high-impact business challenges
  • Design, build, and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and drive data-informed decisions
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies (CNNs, Transformers, GANs, etc.) to build robust models
  • Lead the technical direction of key components and systems
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Tech Leads to deliver deployable solutions
  • Mentor team members and help grow domain expertise
  • Contribute to technical leadership through patents and publications


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and Applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s or PhD in CS, ML, Statistics, or related field (or 8+ years of industry experience)
  • 3+ years building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML/CV techniques: CNNs, Transformers, GANs, optimizers, regularization
  • Strong experience with experiment design, A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, and feature engineering
  • Proficiency in Python and scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas)
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn)
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with experiment automation tools (Ray Tune, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail problems
  • Familiarity with MLOps pipelines and tools
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on measurable business impact

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Pessoa Supervisora de Negócios - Belém (Pará)
description:
Assegurar o crescimento sustentável do faturamento e a excelência operacional nas parcerias sob sua gestão, atuando como facilitador entre as áreas internas (Crédito, TI, Marketing) e o parceiro, visando a maximização de resultados e a fidelização do ecossistema de negócios.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Relacionamento com parceiros, equipe comercial, financeira, crédito, marketing e TI;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho operacional, comercial e volume de faturamento ;
  • Apresentação de resultados mensal para as parcerias sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Realizar visitas a clientes e parceiros;
  • Efetuar treinamento da nossa ferramenta e produtos aos parceiros;
  • Desenvolver e implantar ações para alavancar faturamento nas parcerias sob sua gestão
  • Envio de bases segmentadas de clientes para análise;
  • Tratamento das demandas diárias de crédito (Aumentos e oportunidades, documentação);
  • Hunter de oportunidades, dentro das parcerias sob sua gestão;
  • Direcionamento para aprovação de campanhas;
  • Interação com a equipe de TI para resolução de problemas e melhorias;
  • Ponto focal para agendas com os times dos parceiros.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência na área comercial com crédito B2B, ou em empresas de meios de pagamentos;
  • Pacote Office avançado (Excel, Word e Power Point);
  • Ensino Superior completo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Atuação na região do Pará e demais regiões;
  • Necessário ter veículo próprio.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) .NET SR

  • Automatizar build, testes e deploy com Docker, Kubernetes e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Aplicar TDD e conduzir testes de integração e de carga, assegurando performance e estabilidade.

  • Backend: C#, .NET 6+, Entity Framework Core, API Full Rest
  • Segurança: Certificados Digitais, OAuth2
  • DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
  • Testes: TDD, Testes de Integração e Carga
  • Conhecimento em meios de pagamento (com padrão de mensagem ISO 8583)


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Wiper
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give an unique development opportunity for our seafarers. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.


This job opportunity is for an Wiper to one of our foreign-flagged Shuttle Tankers with a 42x42 shift and international crew. We are looking for qualified and committed professionals to join our team.


Requirements:

- Bridge watch (Rule III/4)

- Tank low.g. Oil (EBPQ) V/1

- Security duties training (EFNT/EBCP) VI/6

- CIR

- Passport

- Yellow fever vaccine

- 2nd Dose COVID-19 (ConectSUS)

- Advanced English


Benefits:

-Food voucher

-Health plan extended to dependents, free of charge

-Life insurance, free of charge

-Boarding and disembarking assistance

-Double food voucher in December

-Wellhub membership: Gold+ plan 100% covered by the company


Note: All logistics are the responsibility of KNOT, regardless of your state of residence.


If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals and offers development opportunities, apply with us.


All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Analista de Sistemas Mainframe SR
description:
A Foursys é apaixonada por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas.

♿


Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece.

Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade


Sobre a oportunidade:

Se você tem forte experiência em Mainframe, gosta de atuar desde o levantamento de requisitos até a entrega da solução e se sente confortável tanto na análise quanto no desenvolvimento, essa oportunidade é para você.

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Sistemas Mainframe com perfil analítico, visão sistêmica e capacidade técnica para atuar em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade. Você será responsável por sustentar e evoluir sistemas legados estratégicos, garantindo estabilidade, performance e qualidade nas entregas.

Aqui, você atuará diretamente na análise, desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas online e batch, sendo peça-chave na sustentação e modernização do ambiente Mainframe.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to support high-impact technology initiatives across multiple consulting engagements. This role focuses on building scalable applications and collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve complex technical challenges.

You will be involved across the entire development lifecycle, from architecture discussions to production deployment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop scalable end-to-end applications.
  • Collaborate with consulting and product teams to solve complex technological challenges.
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and system design.
  • Build and maintain APIs and backend services.
  • Participate in production deployments and delivery acceleration.
  • Ensure applications meet performance, security, and scalability standards.


Requirements

  • Intermediate to upper-intermediate English level (B2 minimum).
  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Full-stack Developer.
  • Strong coding skills in at least one of the following languages: Python, Java, Kotlin, Node.js, Go, Ruby, Rust and C#.
  • Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as: React, Next.js or Angular.
  • Experience developing REST or GraphQL APIs
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Spark or Hadoop.
  • Docker or Kubernetes.
  • CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or CircleCI.
  • Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.

Benefits

  • Career development plan and continuous learning.
  • Excellent work environment and flexibility as a CONTRACTOR.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Direct hiring with us.
  • English Class.
  • Benefits platform.
  • Continuous training communities/Certs.
  • AC points (bonus).
  • National Holidays.
  • Company Events (Colombia)
  • Salary: We don't have fixed salary ranges; we tailor the economic offer based on the candidate's salary expectations. In this case, you will let us know your monthly service fee as a CONTRACTOR, and that value will be taken into account when making the offer.


If you’re looking for a place where professional growth goes hand in hand with quality of life, this opportunity is for you!

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Senior Product Designer (2 Openings)

Contract: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor (PJ)


We are hiring two Senior Designers to support a complex, enterprise-scale environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, navigates sophisticated stakeholder ecosystems, and drives design across overlapping product areas.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead end-to-end product design (problem framing → user flows → interaction patterns → UI → validation)
  • Translate ambiguous or messy requirements into clear UX direction and prioritized scope
  • Facilitate stakeholder workshops and working sessions to drive alignment and decision-making
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to plan increments and define trade-offs
  • Produce high-quality Figma deliverables (journeys, IA, wireframes, prototypes, specifications)
  • Coach and support mid-level designers when needed


Must-Have Requirements

  • Expert-level Figma execution (this is non-negotiable)
  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills
  • Experience working in large, complex, and robust enterprise environments
  • Background in regulated, technical, or high-compliance industries
  • Ability to operate across UX and visual design
  • Working knowledge of research methodologies


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in Healthcare or Financial Services
  • Analytics background
  • Experience with workshop tools (Miro, FigJam)
  • Service blueprinting experience

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Cód. 58141


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Dev, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Java Backend + Spring avançado (Spring Boot, Data, Cache, MVC, Security etc.)
  • AWS na prática (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFormation e afins)
  • Arquitetura moderna : microsserviços, mensageria (Kafka/SQS) e containers (Docker)
  • Bancos de dados : relacionais (SQL/Aurora/Redshift/PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (BigQuery/Firestore/MongoDB/ElasticSearch)
  • Engenharia de entrega e qualidade : CI/CD + Git, testes automatizados (unit/integr/API) e integração com bancos (relacional e NoSQL)


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high- trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)
description:
Job Title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)

Location - Brazil


Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Clinical Statistical Programmer to support clinical trial data standardization, analysis, and regulatory submissions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM), SAS programming, and generation of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), along with experience in quality control and submission readiness.

Key Responsibilities

· Transform raw clinical trial data into CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets

· Develop, validate, and maintain Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for clinical study reports and regulatory submissions

· Write efficient, well-documented SAS programs for data cleaning, derivations, and reporting

· Develop reusable Python or R scripts for automation, validation, and reproducible reporting

· Perform programming QC and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and traceability

· Prepare and maintain programming specifications, mapping documents, and annotated


CRFs

· Troubleshoot complex data integration and derivation issues

· Support audits and regulatory inspections with reproducible code and documentation


Required Qualifications

· Strong experience with SAS programming

· Hands-on experience with CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM)

· Experience generating TLFs for regulatory submissions

· Knowledge of clinical trial data structures and submission processes

· Familiarity with Python or R for automation (preferred)

· Strong attention to detail and documentation practices


Preferred

· Experience supporting FDA/EMA regulatory submissions

· Prior experience in a Pharma, Biotech, or CRO environment

title: Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)
description:
Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager (Technical) to join our 24/7 operations team, which operates at the core of platform stability, partner communication, and incident handling. In this role, you’ll work on the frontline monitoring platform health, investigating issues, and coordinating real-time responses to ensure stable and reliable operations for our partners. This role is about real-time reaction, investigation, coordination, and clear communication.


Responsibilities:  


  • Actively monitor platform health and alerts during your shift and react to incidents in real time
  • Investigate partner-raised issues and perform first-level technical analysis using logs and monitoring dashboards
  • Communicate clearly with partners during incidents, outages, and escalations
  • Own issues throughout their full life cycle: detection, investigation, coordination, and resolution
  • Create and manage Jira tickets and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams
  • Provide transparent updates internally and externally
  • Identify recurring issues and risks that may impact platform stability
  • Maintain accurate documentation and structured internal communication


Requirements:


  • Junior to early-mid level profile 
  • Strong written and verbal English skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-responsibility environment
  • Logical, analytical thinker with a structured approach to problem solving
  • Technically curious and comfortable working with system behavior, logs, and monitoring tools
  • Experience or familiarity with Jira, Slack, or similar tools
  • Able to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as part of a 24/7 rotation
  • Calm under pressure and confident handling incidents and escalations


Things we consider as an advantage:


  • Experience in Customer Support, Customer Success, Technical Support, NOC, or Operations
  • Experience with monitoring tools
  • Exposure to SaaS, platform-based products, or iGaming
  • Basic understanding of web technologies, APIs, or backend systems


Working with us implies:


  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills.

We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Interest in applied AI and automation-driven development.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

We only accept CVs that are in English.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, color, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be disregarded.

title: Profissional Cientista de Dados
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Estamos buscando um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Inteligência Artificial, com foco no desenvolvimento de agentes corporativos baseados em LLMs .

Buscamos profissional com:

✔️ +5 anos em Ciência de Dados / Machine Learning

✔️ Experiência prática com IA Generativa e LLMs

✔️ Arquitetura RAG (embeddings, bancos vetoriais, retrieval)

✔️ Construção de agentes (ReAct / tool calling)

✔️ Prompt engineering e mitigação de hallucinations

✔️ Python, NLP, APIs REST, SQL

✔️ Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Especialista Azure
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Requisitos e Atividades


• Arquitetura Azure: Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando o framework de boa arquitetura da MS.

• Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.

• Modernização: Liderar a transição de workloads legados (On-premises/VMs) para arquiteturas modernas (PaaS, IaaS, SaaS e Containers).

• Automação e DevOps: Evoluir as rotinas de automação para uma cultura de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando Terraform ou Bicep.

• Identidade e Segurança: Conhecimento em B2C, EntraID garantindo políticas de acesso seguro (Conditional Access, RBAC).

• Gestão de Performance: Monitorar proativamente a saúde do ambiente Azure (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights)


Habilidades Técnicas:

• Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.

• Domínio Microsoft: Sólido conhecimento em AKS, ferramentas dos ambientes IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.

• Cloud: Experiência prática em administração de recursos Azure (Networking, App Services e Storage).

• Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.

• Resiliência: Experiência em planos de Disaster Recovery (DR) e atuação em crises com elaboração de laudos de causa raiz (RCA).


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora Comercial
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Conduzir as negociações comerciais (renovação, retenção de lojistas, mudanças de locatários e movimentações estratégicas de lojistas, discussões contratuais, etc) através de reuniões com os lojistas buscando garantir o planejamento anual do Shopping e atingimento do resultado esperado pelos empreendedores;
  • Gestão jurídica contratual e ações relacionadas ao empreendimento;
  • Contribuir com a elaboração e principalmente execução do planejamento estratégico e orçamento plurianual do Shopping por meio de participação em comitês comerciais semanais e demais rotinas junto ao time de Analistas, Assistentes, Estagiário e Auxiliares;
  • Garantir a veracidade das informações e todos os KPIS da área comercial, que auxiliarão na tomada de decisão do Shopping através da consolidação e análise de relatórios gerenciais;
  • Maximizar os recursos disponíveis com o objetivo de rentabilizar todas as linhas de receita do empreendimento, principalmente as linhas ligadas aos resultados, assim como na otimização dos custos;
  • Realizar a gestão de pessoas do time.

  • Ensino Superior completo em Economia, Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou correlatas;
  • Vivência na área comercial e técnicas de negociação;
  • Conhecimentos avançados de Excel, Power BI e análogos;
  • Desejável vivência na área financeira (Análise DRE, fluxo de caixa, gestão orçamentária, noções jurídicas do mercado mobiliário, contábeis/tributarias).
