title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:


  • We are building a team to work on the FreeBSD Performance Monitoring Counter (PMC) framework, including hwmon, libpmc, and pmcstat.
  • The project includes development, testing, and cooperation with the upstream FreeBSD open-source community to integrate new features into FreeBSD.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and improve parts of the FreeBSD PMC framework (hwmon, libpmc, pmcstat)
  • Investigate and fix performance and monitoring issues in the FreeBSD kernel
  • Work with the upstream FreeBSD community and integrate changes into mainline FreeBSD
  • Support performance monitoring tools for modern AMD (Zen era) hardware
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 7 years of experience in relevant technical areas
  • Strong knowledge of FreeBSD kernel architecture and internals
  • Excellent C programming skills
  • Strong understanding of x86 microarchitecture
  • Very good knowledge of performance monitoring on modern x86 systems


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Previous contributions to upstream FreeBSD kernel code
  • Experience with AMD Zen performance monitoring technologies (PMC, IBS, etc.)

title: Supervisor de Contas Médicas - Oncologia
description:
Requisitos:


- Superior completo.

-Excel intermediário;

-Necessário boa vivência com faturamento, auditoria de contas, conhecimento com contratos e aditivos assinados com os convênios, fechamento e análise de contas e operação de sistemas.




Atividades:


-Solicitar ao moto boy e/ou auxiliar administrativo que peguem as guias nas unidades e hospitais quando necessário;

-Receber e controlar diariamente as guias de atendimentos das unidades e hospitais;

- Mensurar o recebimento em planilha e enviar para os envolvidos no processo, sinalizando as pendências, quando for o caso;

-Distribuir a demanda das guias entre os funcionários, garantindo o equilíbrio;

-Definir a demanda do faturista curinga, observando a necessidade diária do setor;

-Cobrar as pendências não entregues, garantindo o envio dentro do cronograma do convênio e no menor tempo possível;

-Mensurar a produção diária e as guias não faturadas em planilha e enviar aos envolvidos;

- Analisar as contas fechadas pelos faturistas com o objetivo de verificar a exatidão das cobranças, orientando-os sempre que necessário;

-Sinalizar para as áreas as inconsistências encontradas nas contas com o objetivo de melhorar o desempenho de completude;

-Sugerir e/ou apoiar as áreas na solução dos problemas identificados;

-Mensurar em planilha as inconsistências encontradas nas contas e enviar mensalmente a Gerência;

-Fechar contas de consulta e procedimentos;

-Realizar o processo de auditoria de contas com os convênios que fazem pré-análise, sinalizando a Gerência sempre que houver glosas indevidas;

-Realizar contato com médicos, enfermagem, recepção, pacientes e convênios sobre os processos de faturamento e etc.




Outras informações:


- Local de trabalho: ASA SUL - Brasilia(DF);

- Escala de trabalho: 5x2 - Seg à Sex (08h às 18h) / Sex - 08h às 17h.

- Disponibilidade para treinamento.

description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

title: Coordenador Operacional  - Elétrica
description:
Líder mundial em Recursos Humanos, a Adecco está presente em 60 países, por meio de uma rede de 5.500 delegações que diariamente proporcionam emprego a 700.000 pessoas e prestam serviços a mais de 100.000 empresas. Faz parte da Fortune Global 500 e está cotada na bolsa de Zurique. A Adecco possui uma estrutura global orientada para a oferta de soluções integradas em Recursos Humanos, com o compromisso de desenvolver continuamente serviços eficazes e competitivos para seus clientes.

Assessoramos importante empresa no segmento de Engenharia e Serviços Operacionais de Energia.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Responsável pela gestão operacional dos processos de manutenção em linha morta e linha viva, poda de árvores, serviços de rede (corte, religação e ligações novas) e plantão para atendimentos emergenciais;
  • Planejar, gerenciar e monitorar a demanda técnica fornecida pela Contratante visando garantir a produtividade, qualidade e segurança dos serviços prestados;
  • Apresentar periodicamente ao Gerente de Contrato e/ou Diretoria, relatórios financeiros e operacionais, por meio de gráficos e planilhas, propondo medidas de melhoria de acordo com os resultados obtidos;
  • Gestão dos indicadores operacionais da Contratante (DEC, FEC, Torre de Investimento, Plano de Manutenção etc.);
  • Gestão dos indicadores financeiros de produção e medição de serviços e de custo do contrato.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino superior Completo em Engenharia Elétrica;
  • CNH B;
  • Conhecimento em manutenção de redes de distribuição de energia elétrica, incluindo atividades em linha viva e linha morta;
  • Experiência em gestão operacional de equipes de campo, especialmente em serviços de rede elétrica (corte, religação, ligações novas e poda de árvores);
  • Gestão e análise de indicadores;
  • Excel Intermediário;
  • Experiência no setor elétrico na distribuição de energia em concessionárias ou empresas prestadoras de serviços;
  • Disponibilidade para residir no Norte e Nordeste;



Benefícios:

- Assistência Médica

- Assistência Odontológica

- Vale alimentação

- Auxilio Moradia

- Vale transporte

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Engenheiros de Dados
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de Dados experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Liderar a implantação de Data Lakes e Lakehouses, atuando tanto no desenho da arquitetura quanto no desenvolvimento hands-on da solução.

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados eficientes e escaláveis para garantir a fluidez entre sistemas.

• Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados em todas as etapas do pipeline.

• Otimizar processos de armazenamento e recuperação de dados, garantindo desempenho e custo eficientes (FINOPS).

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de negócio e tecnologia para transformar requisitos em soluções robustas de dados.

• Implementar e monitorar processos ETL/ELT e arquiteturas de processamento de dados em tempo real e batch.

• Apoiar a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de dados dentro do time.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de pipelines de dados escaláveis (preferencialmente em Oracle Cloud).

• Proficiência em SQL, Python e ferramentas de processamento de dados distribuídos (como Spark).

• Conhecimento avançado em Infrastructure as Code e práticas de CI/CD.

• Experiência com modelagem de dados e arquitetura de Data Lakes e Lakehouses.

• Forte entendimento de práticas de governança e qualidade de dados.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês fluente

title: Python Developer
description:
Python GCP Developer


Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Remote

Experience: Mid to Senior


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement serverless cloud solutions using GCP Cloud Functions;
  • Design data models and manage largescale data storage with GCP Bigtable;
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud functions and associated services;
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate deployment and monitoring of cloud functions;
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cloud infrastructure and application performance;
  • Mentor and support team members in adopting best practices for Python and GCP development;
  • Document technical designs processes and best practices for knowledge sharing;
  • Engage with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions;
  • Ensure adherence to security best practices in cloud deployments;
  • Stay updated with the latest GCP advancements and industry trends.


Mandatory Knowledge

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience;
  • 5 to 7 years of experience in development;
  • Proficiency in Python, GCP Bigtable and GCP Cloud Functions;
  • Hands on experience with designing data models, developing and automation and deployment of cloud functions.



Does this sounds like something you'd like to do?

Apply and attach your resume in English and we'll take it from here. Excited to meet you!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Key Responsibilities


  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Use AI tools (Nanobanana, Freepik AI, Magic Canva Studio) to generate engaging videos and simple animations for social media.
  • Editing videos and creating simple animations for social media use.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications


  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Experience working with video editing tools like Premiere, CapCut, and Canva.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, Claude, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English


Our operating hours are 9 A.M. to 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

· Desenvolver e otimizar modelos semânticos, garantindo governança, performance e clareza executiva.

title: ServiceNow Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript e Glide API
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow:
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Automated Test Framework
  • Service Portal
  • Performance Analytics
  • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
  • CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

title: Senior SRE/Platform Engineer (Python/Go)
description:
About the role

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and automation
  • Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems
  • Understanding of application observability, monitoring, and performance best practices
  • Good spoken English


Responsibilities:

  • Develop automation and tooling to improve system monitoring, incident response, and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using IaC technologies like Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Write production-grade code (Python or Go) to automate infrastructure management and operational workflows.
  • Establish and enhance observability practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable software delivery.
  • Partner with developers to embed reliability and performance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Analista de Dados (Engenharia & Integração SAP)
description:
Analista de Dados (Engenharia & Integração SAP)


100% Remoto

PJ


Estamos em busca de um Analista de Dados para atuar diretamente na migração e descomissionamento de sistemas SAP (ECC → S/4HANA) , apoiando o time de Engenharia e Arquitetura de Dados.


O profissional será responsável por executar atividades práticas de integração, mapeamento e migração de dados, garantindo qualidade e rastreabilidade em todo o processo.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar o processo de migração de dados entre os ambientes SAP ECC e S/4HANA.
  • Realizar o mapeamento de origens, transformações e regras de negócio utilizando SAP Data Services (DS) .
  • Conduzir análises de dados e validações de qualidade para garantir consistência e completude.
  • Executar atividades de integração com SAP SLT (fontes S/4) e DS (fontes ECC) .
  • Colaborar com o time técnico na construção de pipelines e processos de carga para o Data Lake (Databricks, Synapse, Azure SQL) .
  • Documentar processos, tabelas e fluxos de dados, assegurando rastreabilidade e governança.
  • Apoiar a equipe no descomissionamento dos ambientes legados.


Atividades práticas do dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver e ajustar jobs no SAP Data Services .
  • Mapear tabelas de origem SAP e relacionar com os destinos no ambiente cloud.
  • Criar documentação e planilhas de mapeamento e data lineage.
  • Fazer testes de extração, transformação e carga, acompanhando logs e performance.
  • Participar de checkpoints técnicos com equipe de Engenharia e Coordenação.
  • Apoiar análises de erros, inconsistências e ajustes nas integrações.


Experiências desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior com SAP Data Services (DS) e integrações SAP ECC / S/4HANA .
  • Conhecimento em integrações SLT e fluxos de replicação entre sistemas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de migração ou descomissionamento de sistemas SAP .
  • Desejável conhecimento em Databricks, Synapse ou Azure SQL .
  • Perfil hands on, analítico e proativo , com boa organização e atenção a detalhes.
  • Disponibilidade para início imediato (ASAP) .

title: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Descrição do Cargo:

Será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, LookerML, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect

Location: Remote (Brazil)

About Sphise Technologies

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .

What You Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience ( Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Desenvolvedor(a) IOS Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) iOS para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicativos mobile para o ecossistema Apple. Essa pessoa será responsável por construir novas funcionalidades, evoluir a arquitetura das aplicações e garantir qualidade, performance e escalabilidade do código .

Buscamos alguém com boa autonomia técnica, atenção à qualidade do código e que goste de colaborar com times multidisciplinares.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicativos iOS utilizando Swift
  • Escrever código limpo, organizado e de fácil manutenção
  • Traduzir protótipos e designs em interfaces funcionais e bem estruturadas
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com designers, desenvolvedores backend e outros membros do time
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e contribuir para evolução da arquitetura das aplicações
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs e problemas de performance
  • Realizar integração com APIs e serviços backend
  • Acompanhar tendências e boas práticas do ecossistema iOS

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Domínio da linguagem Swift
  • Domínio de Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO)
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de interfaces utilizando Auto Layout e Interface Builder (Storyboards e XIBs)
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura MVVM
  • Familiaridade com design patterns como Delegate, Notification e Injeção de Dependências
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de dependências utilizando CocoaPods
  • Conhecimento dos frameworks nativos da Apple e das Human Interface Guidelines
  • Experiência no consumo de APIs RESTful e manipulação de JSON
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git (Gitflow)
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis

Você irá se destacar se:

  • Experiência com publicação e gerenciamento de aplicativos na App Store
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de software mobile
  • Experiência com automação de testes para aplicações mobile
  • Experiência com Firebase
  • Experiência com integração com APIs e SDKs nativos do iOS

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+ ;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass ;
  • Seguro de vida.

Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo .

title: Virtual Assistant – Real Estate Operations & Executive Support
description:
Polaris Advisors is a high-performing real estate team at Compass , specializing in residential sales, investments, and advisory services in South Florida. Known for its strategic approach, strong operational structure, and client-focused execution, Polaris Advisors delivers a high-level experience across every stage of the real estate process.


We are seeking a high-performing Virtual Assistant based in Brazil to support our Real Estate Operations and Marketing team at a high-producing team at Compass . This is a remote position for candidates located in Brazil , compensated in Brazilian Reais (BRL) .


This role requires a professional who is highly organized, detail-oriented, tech-savvy , and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven U.S. real estate environment .


You will work closely with the Real Estate Operations Manager and the Principal of the team , supporting property listings, marketing initiatives, and operational workflows. This position is ideal for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, and consistently delivers high-quality execution.


Training will be provided on MLS systems and the Compass platform , and the ideal candidate must demonstrate a strong ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools and technologies.


Key Responsibilities


Administrative Operations

• Prepare and manage buyer and seller documentation using the Compass platform

• Organize and maintain internal trackers, digital files, and compliance documentation using Google Drive and Compass systems

• Maintain the listing and transaction pipeline with accurate and up-to-date information

• Coordinate post-closing follow-ups, including testimonial requests


Listing & Deal Coordination

• Coordinate listing preparation, including ordering photography, signage, and related services

• Upload and manage listings across Compass, MLS, Zillow, and related platforms

• Prepare marketing materials, including social media posts, open house flyers, and email blasts

• Ensure full compliance with Compass systems and listing requirements

• Monitor and update status changes across all platforms in real time


Marketing & Lead Management

• Design and distribute e-blasts, brochures, newsletters, and social media posts using the Compass Marketing Center

• Manage the team’s Instagram and Facebook pages, supporting content creation, scheduling, and posting

• Coordinate print campaigns and seasonal marketing drops, including mail execution via Postalytics

• Support lead management and follow-ups as needed


Events & Client Support

• Present and organize vendor quotes (venues, invitations, catering, promotional items)

• Support team events and client-facing initiatives as needed

Qualifications

• Minimum 3+ years of experience in a support role such as Executive Assistant, Operations, or Marketing

• Real estate experience strongly preferred, particularly in U.S. real estate operations

• Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using: Google Workspace, E-signature tools, CRM systems, Canva, and AI (ChatGPT)

• Strong written communication skills, with excellent grammar and clarity

• Highly detail-oriented and process-driven, with the ability to manage follow-ups, deadlines, and shifting priorities independently

• Ability to organize tasks, track progress, and proactively flag issues

• Professional, confident, and polished demeanor when interacting with clients, agents, and vendors

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, time-sensitive real estate environment

• Ability to work independently while maintaining clear, proactive communication and status updates

• Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus


Compensation & Perks

• R$4,000 per month (paid in Brazilian Reais)

• This is a remote position, compensated in BRL (R$)

• Opportunity for growth as the team and responsibilities expand

• Performance-based growth opportunities are available. Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed based on performance, consistency, and contribution to the team.

• Work Schedule (Eastern Time):

Monday, Wednesday, Friday: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM

Tuesday and Thursday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

• Paid time off:

7 holidays

First year: 1 week of paid vacation

From the second year onward: 2 weeks of paid vacation

title: Desenvolvedor Java/ Springboot - Sênior
description:
Pessoa desenvolvedora Backend Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e serviços backend de alta qualidade e eficiência, utilizando Java e SpringBoot.
  • Colaborar com times de frontend e outros stakeholders para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos de negócio e técnicos.
  • Documentar as soluções e práticas adotadas no desenvolvimento.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java.
  • Conhecimento do framework SpringBoot e suas principais bibliotecas e módulos (Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring MVC, etc).
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL) e noSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.
  • Experiência com controle de versão, preferencialmente Git.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD (ex: Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços e em servidores de aplicação leve.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.

Key responsibilities:

- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.

Requirements:

- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Tech Lead JavaScript FullStack Developer
description:
Tech Lead JavaScript FullStack Developer

Brazil

Software Engineer Lead

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As the Tech Lead for our JavaScript/TypeScript full‑stack team, you will guide technical direction, drive architectural decisions, and serve as a key technical counterpart to our client stakeholders. You’ll be a great contributor to the code quality and security aspects, while actively coaching engineers to deepen the team’s expertise in our core stack. You’ll be hands-on and equally strong in communication—facilitating technical discussions, translating business needs into technical plans, and ensuring we commit secure, scalable, and high‑quality solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • As a technical lead, be a reference when communicating with the team and stakeholders (including the client);
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Development of new features;
  • Maintenance of existing applications;
  • Help define and document practices, methodologies and processes relevant to technical teams, improving Encora’s knowledge base;
  • Implement solution from coding to testing to production deployment support;
  • Mentor less experienced team members.

Essential Skills

  • Broad experience with full stack development based in JavaScript;
  • Experience with analysis, design, and implementation;
  • Experience NextJS and NodeJS;
  • Cloud knowledge (specially AWS Lambda, AWS CDK and serverless).

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Knowledge about agile software development;
  • Experience in driving Scrum rituals (Planning, Daily, Review and Retrospective).

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Software Developer (C# / .NET)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Developer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in C# and .NET to join our U.S. client's engineering team. You will lead, develop, and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms, particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystems, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.

Our client provides innovative software solutions for automobile retailers, having led the market since 2014. With over 6,000 customers across North America, the company enhances the buying experience with cutting-edge software that eases communication and converts interest into purchases. Backed by private equity, the company's software features span website conversion, sales enablement, service offers management, retention marketing, and communication through the lenses of valuations, payments, inventory merchandising, and video.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex web applications using C# and .NET, ensuring high-quality code standards and architectural best practices
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable software solutions
  • Drive technical decision-making for system architecture, technology stack choices, and development processes while maintaining comprehensive documentation and testing strategies
  • Follow agile software development processes, collaborating with both onshore and offshore teams
  • Contribute to the development of cloud-based software using Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, Salesforce APEX and Lightning, PostgreSQL, AWS, MongoDB,.NET, PHP, RoR, Python, ETL/Data feeds, and Heroku
  • Continuously learn and adopt new technologies to improve product functionality

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5-10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Experience with expertise in C# and .NET
  • Experience in Salesforce Lightning and SLDS, APEX, Batch, External Client Apps (Connected App), Remote setting, Salesforce Revenue Cloud with legacy applications, and NetSuite
  • Experience in Business intelligence QuickSight developers, ETL process, and data extraction
  • Strong proficiency in database design and management (Salesforce Objects and triggers, MongoDB, SQL), RESTful API development, and cloud services integration with experience in CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in leading software product development projects
  • Hands-on experience leading technical teams both onshore, offshore & nearshore
  • Working under limited supervision and developing code for new business features based on functional and technical specs
  • Decomposes features for a sprint team into tasks that can be accomplished within a sprint; Provides work BPLOE for tasks
  • Understands and adheres to the area's software lifecycle process
  • Communicates across and outside of the team to answer questions, resolve issues, and assess impacts on other teams of changes being made in their sprint team
  • Learns and utilizes new technologies as required, serves as an expert technical resource, advisor, and mentor in one or more feature sets or technologies supported by the development team
  • Provides technical mentorship and work task direction to a team of developers; able to fill the Technical Owner role on an agile sprint team, holding people accountable for task delivery
  • Works with product management to groom and select Features for their area to be included in upcoming releases
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Knowledge of authentication systems (OAuth/OICS, OWASP security best practices, including rate limiting and data encryption
  • Familiarity with AWS services, monitoring tools, and DevOps practices, with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and implement effective solutions
  • Experience with DMS and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Cox/VinSolutions, DealerSocket, DealerAccess), and VIN providers (e.g., DataOne, Polk, VinPower)
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4), Tag Manager (GTM), or Tag Assistant (GTA)
  • Knowledge of SaaS environments and SDLC methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Roadmap Release)
  • Knowledge in Business Intelligence tools, ETL, or reporting

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Software Developer (C# / .NET)

You will lead, develop, and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms, particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystems, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.

Our client provides innovative software solutions for automobile retailers, having led the market since 2014. title: Corporate Content Creator
description:
Company Overview:

Lean Tech is a fast-growing technology company based in Medellín, Colombia, with a strong network in software development and IT services across the entertainment, financial, and logistics industries. The company offers significant opportunities for professional growth while working with engineering teams across Latin America and the United States on innovative projects. Lean Tech is seeking a Mid-level Corporate Content Creator & Training Evangelist to design and deliver high-quality multimedia training materials that communicate company initiatives, operational standards, and internal programs. This role combines content creation, instructional design, and corporate communication to transform complex operational and technical topics into clear, engaging materials such as documents, presentations, videos, and visual assets. The position will work closely with Operations, Product, Technology, Compliance, and Business Application teams to identify knowledge gaps and develop scalable training programs that enhance employee performance and operational excellence.

Position title: Mid-level Corporate Content Creator

Location: Remote - LATAM

Key Responsibilities:

Content Creation & Corporate Communication

  • Develop high-quality written content including structured documentation, manuals, process guides, and corporate communications using tools such as Microsoft Word and Visio.
  • Produce professional video content, visual assets, and multimedia training materials that effectively communicate company processes, systems, and initiatives.
  • Create engaging PowerPoint presentations, PDF learning materials, and visual storytelling assets for internal education and corporate messaging.
  • Design and produce multimedia learning content including tutorials, explainer videos, diagrams, infographics, and process walkthroughs.
  • Ensure all content follows corporate communication standards, branding, and messaging consistency.

Training Program Design & Instructional Development

  • Design, develop, and implement training curriculums tailored to employee roles and operational requirements.
  • Build structured learning programs including:
  • Best practices
  • Work instructions
  • Process documentation
  • Continuous improvement initiatives
  • Maintain and facilitate training curriculum, demonstrations, documentation, and certification programs for employees across different operational areas.
  • Develop training programs for New Hire Onboarding and Continuous Development, including defined milestones and certification expectations.
  • Create training frameworks that support different learning styles and modern learning methods (visual, video-based, interactive).

Training Delivery & Evangelization

  • Act as a corporate evangelist for training initiatives, promoting adoption of best practices and operational standards across the company.
  • Facilitate training workshops, demos, and learning sessions for internal teams.
  • Drive adoption of training content and learning initiatives through clear communication and engaging delivery methods.

Training Strategy & Performance Monitoring

  • Define and analyze training effectiveness metrics, measuring performance, adoption, and knowledge retention.
  • Monitor training program outcomes to ensure alignment with company standards, compliance policies, and operational procedures.
  • Continuously improve training content based on data insights, feedback, and operational changes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Business Application Owners, Operations Leadership, Product, Technology, and Compliance teams to identify training gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Work with stakeholders across regions to ensure training programs reflect operational differences by region, station, carrier, mode of transport, or client requirements.
  • Collaborate with teams to ensure data quality, process improvements, and workflow alignment within training materials.

Process & Content Governance

  • Maintain structured documentation repositories and ensure training materials remain current and aligned with evolving company processes.
  • Support workflow optimization and documentation standardization across departments.
  • Contribute to training roadmaps and long-term learning strategies.

Required Skills & QualificationsProfessional Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in content creation, corporate training, instructional design, or learning and development roles.
  • Proven experience producing multimedia training materials including documentation, presentations, video, and visual content.
  • Experience designing corporate training programs and internal knowledge frameworks.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and global organizations.

Content & Media Creation Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Visio or similar diagramming tools.
  • Experience creating professional training videos and visual content.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design and modern learning methodologies.
  • Ability to produce structured, well-written documentation with excellent editorial quality.
  • Experience with camtasia or other video and image editing.
  • Experience with Adobe reader or other tools to generate content

Communication Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly.
  • Strong storytelling ability to transform technical information into engaging content.

Analytical & Organizational Skills

  • Strong research and analytical skills to identify training opportunities and learning gaps.
  • Ability to analyze training metrics and continuously improve programs.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple content projects simultaneously.

Collaboration & Work Style

  • Strong collaboration skills across distributed and global teams.
  • Ability to work in ambiguous environments and deliver high-quality results with minimal supervision.
  • Empathy for end users to design intuitive and practical learning experiences.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in corporate training, knowledge management, or learning experience design.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS).
  • Experience in global operations environments such as logistics, transportation, or supply chain.
  • Knowledge of project management frameworks and backlog management tools.

Why you will love Lean Tech:

  • Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology
  • Professional development opportunities with international customers
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels.

Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento back-end utilizando C# , Node.js e Python.
  • Vivência com serviços da AWS , incluindo Apache Flink, S3, EC2, ECS e SQS (entre outros serviços correlatos).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microserviços , incluindo desenho, implementação e manutenção de serviços distribuídos.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento back-end utilizando C# , Node.js e Python.
  • Vivência com serviços da AWS , incluindo Apache Flink, S3, EC2, ECS e SQS (entre outros serviços correlatos).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microserviços , incluindo desenho, implementação e manutenção de serviços distribuídos.

title: Desenvolvedor sênior
description:
Vaga desenvolvedor Sênior


Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.


Sobre o cargo: Como Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior, você vai atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas, APIs e serviços que compõem ao ecossistema de produtos da empresa.


Responsabilidades Principais:


  • Criar e manter APIs/Serviços, garantindo performance, segurança e escalabilidade.
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, além de otimizar sistemas para melhorar a performance.
  • Trabalhar na integração de sistemas internos e de terceiros.
  • Participar de reuniões para entendimento de requisitos, refinamento de demandas e planejamento de sprints.
  • Escrever testes automatizados (unitários, integração e end-to-end) para garantir a estabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar sistemas/serviços em produção, analisando logs e métricas para garantir a estabilidade e desempenho dos serviços.
  • Implementar boas práticas de segurança no desenvolvimento, proteção de dados e autenticação de sistemas.
  • Em conjunto com a liderança técnica e arquitetura, avaliar e propor novas ferramentas, tecnologias e práticas para melhorar o ecossistema da empresa
  • Documentar processos e melhorias implementadas.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Proficiência em Java e outras linguagens de programação. (experiência mínima de 4 anos )
  • Graduação concluída na área de TI;
  • Habilidade para identificar e solucionar desafios técnicos de forma eficiente.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código com Git;
  • Noções de banco de dados PostgreSQL e Mongo;
  • Experiência com Quarkus ou Spring Boot ;
  • Busca constante por melhorias nos sistemas e processos existentes.
  • Capacidade de documentar código e comunicar ideias técnicas de forma clara.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolução de problemas: Busca contínua por aprendizado e soluções eficazes. Capacidade de colaborar em equipe, receber feedback construtivo e contribuir para o sucesso do projeto


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior com sistemas legados desenvolvidos a partir do Java 8;
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação Node, Typescript, React e Angular;
  • Familiaridade e experiência com o uso de Docker para implantação e gestão de contêineres;
  • Experiência prévia com aplicativos de gerenciamento de caches e/ou sistemas de filas de eventos.



Por que #VemParaSyonet ? Temos um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e focado na qualidade e cheio de oportunidades para crescer com a gente

title: Executive Headhunter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

The Executive Headhunter position focuses on identifying, attracting, and assessing top talent for senior-level positions. This role combines executive search methodology with talent assessment expertise to place high-performing leaders who can drive organizational success and strategic growth for clients.

Key responsibilities:

- Conducting in-depth interviews and evaluations to assess candidates' qualifications, experience, cultural fit, and potential.

- Designing and executing customized search strategies to identify high-caliber talent for executive or senior-level roles.

- Facilitating the offer process, including salary negotiations and contract discussions, to ensure smooth placements.

- Proactively identifying and attracting top-tier candidates through networking, referrals, market research, and digital platforms.

Requirements:

- Experience: At least 5 years in recruitment, preferably in executive search.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Psychology, Human Resources, or related field.

- Market Knowledge: Experience recruiting for US candidates and commercial openings.

- Assessment Skills: Excellent interviewing and candidate assessment abilities.

- Industry Understanding: Knowledge of various industries and executive roles.

- Work Style: Ability to work independently and manage multiple search assignments.

- Language Skills: Advanced level of English.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

About Sphise Technologies

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.

Position Overview:

For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems

Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Hunter Comercial
description:
O profissional será responsável por toda a jornada de prospecção e qualificação de novos leads, desde a abordagem inicial até a elaboração e apresentação de propostas de serviços da empresa. Atuará estrategicamente para identificar novas oportunidades de negócio, realizar abordagens ativas e engajar leads com as soluções oferecidas pela empresa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar ativamente contas estratégicas e decisores B2B;
  • Realizar o atendimento de novos leads provenientes do Inbound MKT;
  • Realizar abordagens iniciais para identificar necessidades e desafios dos leads;
  • Realizar a qualificação de leads, conforme processo interno;
  • Elaborar e apresentar propostas aos leads qualificados;
  • Realizar follow-up de negociações e acompanhamento de novos contratos;
  • Monitorar métricas, metas e OKRs relacionadas à prospecção e qualificação de leads;
  • Contribuir com insights para a melhoria contínua das estratégias comerciais da empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência ou formação na área de energia elétrica
  • Experiência com prospecção ativa e vendas B2B
  • Técnicas de qualificação de leads e vendas consultivas
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas CRM

Informações:

  • Trabalho 100% remoto;
  • Salário fixo + variável (formato OTE);
  • Cartão iFood;
  • PLR com distribuição anual;
  • Contrato PJ *;

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.
