title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

title: Senior Software Engineer - C#
description:
About the Company

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer, based of Argentina or Brazil, with a strong specialization in C#, software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop and maintain complex .NET / C# based applications, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.

Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Develop strategies for transitioning from legacy systems to modern architectures.
  • Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience as backend developer with a strong focus on C#.
  • Proficient in .NET Framework/.NET Core.
  • Can design RESTful APIs, architect software systems (taking into consideration scalability, maintainability and performance).
  • Emphasizes the importance of testing, automated testing frameworks and writing unit tests.
  • Strong knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL).
  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices, event driven architecture and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure or Google Cloud for development and deployment.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies (e.g., React, Angular) is a plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Fully remote position, with the opportunity to travel to the US.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • The chance to work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technologies.

title: Semi Senior Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role

The Semi Senior Java Developer position focuses on developing and optimizing complex applications using advanced Java skills. This role involves enhancing system performance, implementing sophisticated features, leading smaller project teams or modules, and mentoring junior developers while playing a crucial part in development projects and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

Key responsibilities

- Designing and developing complex Java applications, demonstrating strong problem-solving capabilities and technical expertise.

- Leading smaller project teams or modules, guiding junior developers and ensuring project timelines and coding standards are met.

- Conducting thorough code reviews, enforcing best practices for high-quality, maintainable code across the team.

- Staying updated with advanced Java features and frameworks while mentoring junior team members in their professional development.

- Collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, translating technical and business requirements into robust, scalable solutions.

- Contributing significantly to project planning and execution, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives.

Requirements

- Java Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on experience with Java development.

- APIs and Web Services: Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and Web Services.

- Database Technologies: Practical experience with database systems and data management.

- Algorithm Knowledge: Advanced understanding of algorithms and data structures.

- Infrastructure Basics: Basic IT infrastructure knowledge and deployment practices.

- Software Design: Experience in designing and implementing software modules for real-world applications.

- Testing Proficiency: Proficient in writing and implementing unit tests.

- CI/CD Familiarity: Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior AI Engineer – RAG & MCP (Integrations & Tools)
description:
Remote | Full-time | Voiceflip

Employee located in South America prefered.

Salary $1,200-2,000 usd / month

We’re hiring a senior AI engineer to own RAG systems, MCP, and tool integrations for ARDI — our production AI assistants used by real estate associations and MLSs across North America.

This role is for someone who enjoys turning messy data + APIs into reliable AI tools.


Not prompt hacking. Not research.


What you’ll do

  • Build and improve production RAG pipelines
  • Design and operate MCP servers and tools
  • Connect ARDI to new APIs, datasets, and systems
  • Improve grounding, retrieval accuracy, and trust
  • Debug hallucinations by fixing retrieval and context
  • Work closely with product and customers on real use cases

What we’re looking for

  • Strong hands-on experience with RAG systems
  • Real experience with MCP and tool orchestration
  • Python in production environments
  • Vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
  • Experience with ingestion pipelines and unstructured data
  • Senior-level judgment: you know why things break

Nice to have

  • Azure or cloud-native deployments
  • AI agents / multi-tool systems
  • Search, IR, or NLP background
  • Enterprise or regulated data experience

Why this role

  • Small, senior team
  • Real product-market fit
  • You’ll shape the architecture, not inherit chaos
  • Focus on accuracy, accessibility, and trust

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.

Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Desenvolvedor de Software Java Senior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.

Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.

Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:

Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.

Se você é um(a) desenvolvedor(a) Java experiente, com mais de 5 anos de prática e conhecimento em Java 8+, esta vaga pode ser ideal para você. Valorizamos profissionais que tenham habilidades técnicas sólidas e estejam comprometidos com o crescimento contínuo. Buscamos pessoas que reconheçam a importância da colaboração e da busca por respostas com colegas. Se você se identifica com esses valores e está preparado para desafios estimulantes, inscreva-se. Estamos ansiosos para receber sua inscrição!

Nosso ambiente de trabalho:

  • Trabalhamos com metodologias ágeis
  • Infraestrutura na AWS
  • Integração contínua com Jenkins, Sonar e Docker
  • Repositórios no GitHub
  • Intellij IDE (Ultimate)
  • Linux (remotamente) e Mac (no escritório)

Desafios que você vai encontrar:

  • Processamento de milhões de registros em curto espaço de tempo
  • Consulta massiva de dados para alta performance
  • Processamento assíncrono de jobs
  • Ambiente de alta concorrência

title: Product Owner Especialista em ERP Linx Microvix
description:
Vaga: Product Owner Especialista em ERP Linx Microvix

Local: Brasil (remoto)

Área: Produto / Tecnologia / Varejo

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um Product Owner especialista em ERP Linx Microvix para liderar a evolução de soluções voltadas ao varejo. Este profissional será responsável por traduzir necessidades de negócio em funcionalidades de produto, garantindo que o ERP atenda às demandas operacionais, fiscais e estratégicas de redes varejistas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Definir e gerenciar o roadmap do produto relacionado ao ERP Linx Microvix.
  • Priorizar e organizar o backlog de produto , criando e refinando user stories.
  • Traduzir necessidades do negócio em requisitos funcionais claros para o time de desenvolvimento .
  • Atuar como ponto de conexão entre stakeholders e equipes técnicas .
  • Conduzir sessões de refinamento de backlog, planejamento de sprints e reviews .
  • Definir critérios de aceite e validar entregas do time de desenvolvimento.
  • Mapear processos de varejo e propor melhorias operacionais dentro do sistema.
  • Participar da definição e acompanhamento de releases e versões do produto .

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada com ERP Linx Microvix .
  • Experiência como Product Owner, Product Manager ou Analista de Produto .
  • Conhecimento profundo de operações de varejo .
  • Experiência com metodologias Agile / Scrum .
  • Capacidade de elaborar documentação funcional e regras de negócio .
  • Conhecimento em integrações de sistemas e APIs.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com POS de varejo ou soluções omnichannel .
  • Conhecimento em meios de pagamento e carteiras digitais
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia voltadas para varejo.

Competências comportamentais

  • Pensamento analítico
  • Comunicação clara entre áreas técnicas e de negócio
  • Organização e gestão de prioridades
  • Visão estratégica de produto

title: Astound Us Open Call for Illustrators
description:
At Astound Us we are Drawn to better. We aim high, to Astound, by being the agency with the best in contemporary children's book illustration, licensing, and commercial art.

We invite freelance illustrators to submit their work to be considered for representation and to join our roster of artists. This is a fully remote role , enabling you to work from anywhere in the world while building your global reputation as an illustrator.

Here at Astound Us we work closely with our artists to ensure career advancements with the right clients, regular creative guidance , storybook development , direct connections with clients suited to your style, strong administrative support and on-time payment .

We would love to review your work, so there's absolutely no cost associated with your submission.

All submissions are processed by our talent scouts at ITSme , and reviewed in conjunction with our Astound agents.

In order to submit your work, please send a collection of images or a link to your online portfolio/ website to along with some information about you. We will review this and get back to you if you are the right fit to become represented by illo.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

title: Business Analyst (BA)
description:
I am reaching out because we are in need of a new Business Analyst (BA) resource for our team, and I would like to request your support. Below are the details of the profile we are seeking:

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst (BA) to join our team and support initiatives related to our Core Banking systems. This professional will act as a key bridge between business and technology, ensuring clarity of requirements, alignment across teams, and effective delivery of solutions in an Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support Agile ceremonies, including:
  • Daily Scrum (when necessary)
  • Backlog Refinement
  • Sprint Planning
  • Sprint Review
  • Sprint Retrospective (as observer or contributor)
  • Conduct requirements gathering and process analysis
  • Prepare and maintain the product backlog
  • Organize and manage dependencies across teams
  • Validate deliverables to ensure alignment with business needs
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders
  • Leverage JIRA for tracking, documentation, and workflow management

Required Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English
  • Experience with Core Banking systems, including:
  • DDA Accounts
  • Savings Accounts
  • Money Market Accounts
  • Certificates of Deposit (CD)
  • Hands-on experience working in Agile teams
  • Strong knowledge of banking processes and system integration
  • Proven experience with:
  • Requirements gathering
  • Backlog preparation and refinement
  • Dependency management
  • Delivery validation
  • Proficiency with JIRA

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with JHA (Jack Henry & Associates) environment

QUEM SOMOS


TozziniFreire é um escritório full-service com atuação em 55 áreas do Direito Empresarial. Nosso compromisso com a integridade, a responsabilidade social e diversidade e a inclusão social está expresso em nossa missão e é reforçado diariamente em nosso desempenho.


INOVADORES ATÉ PARA INOVAR

Somos pioneiros no desenvolvimento de um programa de inovação interno, o ThinkFuture, que prepara nossos advogados para as transformações digitais e já é referência jurídica nos assuntos que envolvam tecnologia.


NOSSA ATUAÇÃO

Nossa equipe de contencioso cível estratégico é premiada e reconhecida pelo mercado e pelos principais guias nacionais e internacionais. O time tem vasta experiência nos diferentes setores, incluindo Consumidor, Tech Litigation & Data Privacy, em que assessoramos empresas com grandes relevâncias no mercado.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Para nós, a diversidade é peça fundamental do sucesso. Buscamos advogadas (os) Seniores, com inglês fluente e experiência na área do Contencioso Cível Estratégico.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Profissionais com experiência na área do Contencioso Cível Estratégico;
  • Graduação Superior Completa em Direito;
  • OAB Ativa;
  • Inglês Fluente.

title: Customer Support Specialist (POS)
description:
Provide technical support for HungerRush Point of Sale to ensure the stable operation of

customer hardware and software products. This includes troubleshooting, configuring,

maintaining, supporting, and optimizing all HungerRush Point of Sale products, PC

hardware, software, and communication links. This job requires a technical understanding

of IT, an appreciation of the food industry, and strong customer service skills.

Essential Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Provide first class Technical Support over the phone
  • Identify, analyze, and correct technical and software issues
  • Work customer cases efficiently with the goal of optimizing and improving customer

satisfaction

  • Ensure customers issues are dealt with in a timely fashion
  • Ensure that customer satisfaction is maintained
  • Maintain an available status to provide quick response times for customers calls
  • Work closely with other departments to provide prompt resolutions to customer

issues

Education :

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)
  • Preferred – Associates Degree (or higher)

Experience:

  • Must Have: 1-3 years of experience in computer technology (prior help desk or call center experiences supporting a software product a big plus)
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Technical certifications (examples: Net+, CompTIA A+ or an AAS degree or equivalent)
  • Previous experience working in the hospitality industry
  • Familiarity with POS equipment
  • Bilingual Speaker (preferable) (Spanish/English)

What You Need For This Position:

  • Be flexible with working schedules, including nights and weekends
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills
  • Be able to technically troubleshoot and reverse engineer:

1. Windows

2. Networking

3. SQL Server (preferred)

title: Veterinarian
description:
About SignalPET

SignalPET is a fast-growing veterinary AI company working alongside veterinarians and radiologists to deliver faster, more accurate diagnostic support. Our mission is to enhance clinical decision-making through intelligent technology grounded in real-world veterinary medicine.

We are expanding our Medical R&D team in Brazil and are looking for a clinically strong, detail-oriented veterinarian to help build and refine the medical intelligence powering our platform.

The Role

As a Veterinarian – Medical Education & Medical Content , you will transform real SignalPET clinical cases into structured educational modules and high-quality medical marketing content.

You will help build and execute the SignalPET Training Hub & Academy , including CE-accredited learning modules, case-based training, and medical campaigns that strengthen veterinarians’ radiology skills and reinforce SignalPET’s clinical authority.

This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role working closely with:

  • Board-certified radiologists
  • Medical R&D
  • AI and Product teams
  • Marketing

Key Responsibilities

Academy & CE Content Development

  • Develop structured, case-based learning modules using real SignalPET cases
  • Create CE-accredited courses, micro-learning sessions, pathology refreshers, and interactive quizzes
  • Build AI vs. Radiologist comparison educational insights
  • Work with specialists to validate medical accuracy
  • Manage and publish modules inside the Training Hub platform

Medical Marketing Content

  • Write clinically authoritative blogs, case spotlights, white papers, landing page content, and educational campaigns
  • Develop product-related medical materials and sales enablement tools
  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and positioning
  • Ensure scientific credibility through specialist validation

Workflow-Connected Learning

  • Map common clinical findings (e.g., splenic masses, thoracic disease, trauma cases) to relevant Academy modules
  • Collaborate with AI and Product teams to connect case workflows with learning opportunities

Performance & Optimization

  • Define and track CE engagement, learning participation, and content performance metrics
  • Continuously refine modules based on user feedback and clinical data

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Participate in relevant internal meetings
  • Provide medical clarification for marketing and product initiatives
  • Coordinate with specialists and Medical R&D for content validation

Requirements

  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or equivalent
  • Clinical Experience - Hands-on experience in small animal practice
  • Strong radiographic interpretation skills (canine & feline)
  • Radiology-focused experience is a plus
  • Excellent English writing skills (medical & educational content)
  • Ability to translate complex medical topics into clear, structured content
  • Experience creating CE-accredited content is a strong advantage
  • Strong small animal radiology knowledge
  • Ability to collaborate with board-certified specialists
  • Understanding of adult learning principles
  • Comfortable working in CMS and digital platforms

Working Hours

  • Monday to Friday - 7am to 4pm

*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***

This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.

Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.

We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

Why Join SignalPET?

  • Work at the intersection of veterinary medicine and AI
  • Impact thousands of veterinary professionals globally
  • Remote flexibility
  • Be part of a growing, mission-driven team

title: Senior Front-end Developer (React.js) - Project
description:
We are looking for a remote, skilled Senior Front-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React.js to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping ideas and user feedback into delightful experiences, developing and implementing user interface components into the latest React.js concepts and workflows, and leading the engineering efforts for user-facing features. You will work with our product and user experience teams to deliver end-to-end features that deliver business value that users love.

This project has a 6-month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform allows companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the User Experience and Product teams to create end-to-end designs for new features
  • Take ownership of product features from design, implementation, and delivery, to post-delivery feedback and follow-up work
  • Coordinate development efforts across team members and ensure successful delivery
  • Architect, develop, and implement highly-responsive user interface components using JavaScript and React.js
  • Provide technical leadership to teammates through coaching and mentorship
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, and help find and build solutions to their problems

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience as a front-end engineer writing single-page applications that communicate with API back-ends, and knowledge of JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A well-developed understanding of frontend concepts and various frameworks
  • A focus on delivering value to customers
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake

Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field
  • Node.js and Python experience
  • Additional Information
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays annually
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

  • The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Designer instrucional
description:
Busca por Designer Instrucional Sênior

Estou buscando um Designer Instrucional Sênior para desenvolver uma capacitação para minha empresa.

Meu nome é Daniel Burd , sou CEO da Call Daniel , empresa especializada em treinamentos de produtividade para organizações .

Estamos desenvolvendo uma capacitação sobre produtividade pessoal , com carga horária de 6 horas , que será oferecida tanto presencialmente quanto no formato on-line síncrono .

Gostaria de convidar profissionais interessados a avaliar se esta oportunidade faz sentido para seu momento profissional.

Perfil que busco

1 - Experiência sólida em metodologias de Design Instrucional , como 6D, ADDIE ou abordagens equivalentes.

2 - Experiência comprovada em projetos semelhantes , idealmente com:

  • treinamentos de aproximadamente 6 horas de duração
  • público corporativo
  • formato presencial ou híbrido

3 - Disponibilidade para compartilhar ao menos um case semelhante ao desafio descrito , contendo:

  • Artefatos do processo de design instrucional utilizados no desenvolvimento da solução (ex.: diagnóstico, blueprint, jornada de aprendizagem, storyboard etc.), que evidenciem o uso da metodologia.
  • Entregáveis finais , como:
  • apresentação (PPT)
  • material do participante
  • guia do instrutor
  • outros materiais de suporte.
Observação importante

Peço gentilmente que não utilize inteligência artificial para redigir sua mensagem de contato . Tenho recebido textos muito extensos gerados por IA que pouco revelam sobre a experiência real do profissional. Prefiro comunicações simples e diretas, escritas pelo próprio profissional.

Muito grato,

Daniel Burd

CEO – Call Daniel

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.

Key responsibilities:

- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.

Requirements:

- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Delphi Developer
description:
*ROLE BASED IN IRELAND, MUST BE INTERESTED IN RELOCATION*

Our client are looking for a Senior Delphi developer to join their growing team. Our client are a progressive software company who market their own product suites which are both desktop and web based.

Main Technologies

Borland Delphi

Web technologies, HTML, DHTML and Javascript

Oracle, SQLServer, MySQL

Primary Objectives

You will be responsible for the development of core and customer specific elements of the product suite. You will also contribute to the design and development of new modules within the system. The position will also involve a certain level of business-requirements analysis and this may involve direct contact with customers.

Duties include

  • Systems analysis,
  • Specification and design,
  • Development of core product,
  • Research and development,
  • Issue investigation,
  • Software maintenance,
  • Documentation,
  • Other duties as assigned

Required Skills

  • Experience in working in an n-tier web development environment
  • Working knowledge of SQL and database design
  • Excellent communication, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Must be able to work effectively individually and as part of a team

Desirable Skills

Experience in any other OO-based development environments (C++, C#, Java etc.)

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Position Summary:

We are seeking friendly and motivated Customer Support Specialists to serve our

customers and restaurant owners by providing assistance regarding account management

or order inquiries. This could include changes to their account, minor updates to their

menu, or inquiries about an order

Essential Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Take inbound calls from either the customer or the restaurant.
  • Make outbound calls to customers or restaurants to follow up on acknowledgement errors.
  • Manage incoming tickets generated from email or text via CRM (customer relationship management portal).
  • Return calls for any voicemails that a ticket is generated for Minor troubleshooting product or service problems reported by the customer or the restaurant.
  • Route calls / tickets to appropriate channels if necessary.
  • Facilitate and document accurate correspondence between the restaurant and customers
  • Miscellaneous clerical duties.

Education:

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)

Experience:

  • 6+ months work experience (Internship acceptable)
  • Fluent in English - Bilingual Spanish/English preferred
  • Must be available for evening and weekend shifts
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong critical thinking / problem solving skills
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Previous call center experience
  • Food Industry experience

What You Need For This Position:

  • Be flexible with working schedules, including nights and weekends
  • Efficient in operating a computer in a Windows based environment
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills

title: JR Partnership Programs Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.

Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Talent - Performance Specialist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the Role

The Talent Performance Specialist will transform complex data into strategic insights that directly improve individual performance and operational outcomes across Talent Acquisition, working closely with senior stakeholders to become a strategic analytics reference.

Key Responsibilities:

- Consolidating, validating, and maintaining performance dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.

- Analyzing individual and team performance metrics, identifying trends, outliers, and recurring issues to generate actionable, data-driven insights for Talent Acquisition operations.

- Defining, tracking, and evolving KPIs for existing and new Talent Acquisition roles.

- Partnering with Operations and Automation teams, acting as the main point of contact for dashboard changes, data logic updates, and reporting improvements.

Requirements:

- Experience: 2-4 years as a Performance Analyst, Business Analyst, or Data Analyst.

- Performance Metrics: Experience with individual performance KPIs and operational metrics.

- Data Review: Involvement in data-driven performance review processes.

- Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (complex formulas, data validation, querying).

- Experience consolidating data from multiple sources.

- Analytical Skills: Strong understanding of KPIs, trends, outliers, and performance metrics.

- Language: Advanced proficiency in English.

Desirable Skills:

- Experience with Looker Studio or Databricks.

- Basic to intermediate SQL.

- 4+ years in analytics roles linked to Talent, Operations, or QA.

- Experience in fast-growing or scaling environments.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Content Analyst
description:
Career Opportunity: Content Analyst at Hartwell Companies

Hartwell Companies, a leader in industry innovation and a hub for top-tier talent, is on the lookout for an experienced Content Analyst to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to make an impact in a dynamic, growth-oriented organization.

About Us: Hartwell Companies bring together strategically aligned businesses with a shared commitment to growth, innovation, and positive impact. We are a collective of dynamic enterprises, providing management experience, fresh insights, and resources to nurture each brand under our umbrella.

Position: Content Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Model: Contractor Remote

Working Hours: 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Job Description:

The primary purpose of this role is to plan, coordinate, and execute the content strategy for Hartwell companies, including SONCO Safety Marketplace.

The Content Analyst will ensure all website content is SEO-driven and aligned with Information Architecture (IA) best practices to improve search rankings, organic traffic, and user experience.

This role includes creating product descriptions for new product pages, developing content for all website pages, social media, producing customer success cases, and building alliances with organizations, associations, and LinkedIn communities to generate co-marketing initiatives.

Main Responsibilities

  • Plan, create, and distribute valuable content.
  • Lead the development and optimization of website product pages, ensuring excellent user experience and strong SEO performance.
  • Ensure website content supports the SEO strategy, including keyword targeting, internal linking, and Information Architecture improvements to enhance rankings and crawlability.
  • Collaborate with design, video, and content writing teams to produce high-quality, SEO-driven content.
  • Plan and write customer success stories and blog posts for our website. Conduct customer interviews to gather accurate information and brief the copywriting team effectively.
  • Define and pursue alliances with organizations, associations, and LinkedIn communities for co-marketing initiatives.
  • Review and refine digital ad content to ensure consistency and performance alignment.
  • Develop attractive, original content to attract and retain users.
  • Distribute content across channels (website, social media, email, blog).
  • Own and optimize the customer review process.
  • Support the marketing team by conducting client surveys.
  • Measure, analyze, and present results of content strategy efforts, including SEO and organic performance metrics.

Skills and Competencies required:

  • Exceptional writing and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Advanced skill level in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with WordPress.
  • Knowledge of web publishing requirements and content structuring best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with SEO and web traffic metrics.
  • Understanding of Information Architecture (IA) principles and how content structure impacts SEO and user experience.
  • Strong familiarity with various social media platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to use own initiative to progress work and to work to deadlines.
  • Flexible and creative attitude toward problem-solving.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across business units.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory, with the ability to write and interact with the US-based team.

Other details of the position:

  • Contract type: Full-time consultant.
  • Working hours: 8 hours daily (from 8 am to 5 pm EST).

description:

Sobre a Empresa

A EAD Marketing & Assessoria é uma empresa especializada na comercialização de produtos de alto valor no mercado digital, atuando com estratégias estruturadas de vendas e relacionamento com clientes.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Financeiro(a) para integrar nosso time e contribuir com a organização e eficiência das rotinas financeiras da empresa.

Buscamos uma pessoa analítica, organizada, que gosta de trabalhar com números e processos financeiros, proativa, que tenha habilidade para trabalhar com tecnologia e implementar novas tecnologias sempre que necessário.

Local: Campo Grande - MS

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido

Remuneração: Contrato PJ com remuneração inicial de R$ 3.000, com possibilidade de crescimento conforme desempenho.

=> Responsabilidades:

- Realizar controle e acompanhamento do fluxo de caixa

- Apoiar nas rotinas de contas a pagar e contas a receber

- Conciliação bancária e conferência de lançamentos financeiros

- Organização de documentos e suporte às rotinas contábeis

- Interface com a contabilidade quando necessário

=> Requisitos

- Formação em Ciências Contábeis ou estar cursando a partir do 3º ano

  • Buscamos alguém comprometido, com visão de crescimento e que queira contribuir para manter a saúde financeira e a organização dos processos da empresa.

title: Estágio em Customer Success
description:
A Risposta é uma plataforma de inteligência e satisfação de clientes para restaurantes. Hoje estamos presentes em mais de 1.500 casas em todo o Brasil , incluindo grupos como Outback, Aizomê, Moma, Rascal, Origem, entre outros.

Usamos tecnologia e dados para ajudar restaurantes a oferecer experiências cada vez melhores aos seus clientes. Se você tem interesse em experiência do cliente, tecnologia e relacionamento , e quer aprender em um ambiente dinâmico, queremos te conhecer.

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa estagiária para atuar no time de Customer Success , apoiando na jornada dos nossos clientes desde o início da utilização da plataforma.

No dia a dia, você irá:

  • Apoiar na organização e acompanhamento de onboardings de novos clientes
  • Ajudar no acompanhamento do uso da plataforma e identificar possíveis dúvidas ou dificuldades
  • Auxiliar na preparação e condução de treinamentos e apresentações remotas
  • Realizar follow-ups e comunicações de engajamento com clientes
  • Contribuir com o registro de feedbacks e aprendizados dos clientes para os times internos
  • Apoiar na organização de informações e acompanhamento de contas
O que buscamos
  • Estar cursando graduação em áreas como Administração, Comunicação, Marketing, Relações Internacionais, Economia ou áreas correlatas
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes
  • Interesse em experiência do cliente, tecnologia e relacionamento com clientes
  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender
Diferenciais
  • Interesse em negócios B2B ou tecnologia
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de organização ou CRM
  • Interesse por hospitalidade, gastronomia e comportamento do consumidor
O que você encontra na Risposta
  • Ambiente colaborativo e aberto à troca de ideias
  • Contato próximo com diferentes áreas da empresa
  • Aprendizado prático sobre Customer Success e relacionamento com clientes
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver habilidades em um setor que cresce cada vez mais
Informações adicionais

Modelo presencial

Local: Botafogo (RJ), próximo ao metrô

title: Salesforce OEM Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $3,500 - $4,500 USD


We are seeking an experienced Salesforce OEM Developer to design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce-based products using Salesforce’s OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) platform. This role requires deep expertise in Salesforce application development, second-generation managed packages, and modern Salesforce development practices, including a thorough and practical understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits and how to design within them.


Along with our partner, we are seeking a candidate who combines strong engineering skills with deep Salesforce administrator-level knowledge to deliver secure, performant, and upgrade-safe managed solutions deployed across multiple customer orgs.


Key Responsibilities:

Salesforce OEM & Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce OEM solutions using second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Build scalable, upgrade-safe features aligned with Salesforce OEM and ISV best practices
  • Implement application logic using Apex, SOQL, and SOSL, with careful consideration of platform constraints
  • Design solutions that efficiently operate within Salesforce governor limits, including limits related to CPU time, heap size, queries, DML, and concurrent execution
  • Develop modern user experiences using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and the Lightning framework
  • Ensure package versioning, dependency management, and release processes follow Salesforce standards


Platform Configuration & Administration

  • Apply deep Salesforce admin knowledge to design effective, maintainable configurations that complement custom code
  • Build and maintain Flows (record-triggered, screen flows, orchestration), ensuring automation is performant and governor-limit aware
  • Configure and manage profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, roles, and sharing rules
  • Design and maintain page layouts, Lightning Record Pages, and UI customizations
  • Evaluate and balance declarative vs. programmatic solutions to minimize technical debt and reduce risk of governor limit violations


Source Control & DevOps

  • Use Git for source control, including branching, merging, and pull request workflows
  • Collaborate within CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments (e.g., scratch orgs, packaging orgs, automated testing)
  • Support release management processes for managed packages across multiple versions and customers


Quality & Collaboration

  • Write comprehensive unit tests to ensure high code coverage and validate behavior under governor limit constraints
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex performance and limit-related issues across customer environments
  • Collaborate with product, architecture, QA, and support teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions
  • Contribute to technical documentation and Salesforce OEM best practice guidelines


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience developing on the Salesforce Platform, particularly with hands-on experience with Salesforce OEM development.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs
  • Thorough understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits, including how they impact:

○ Apex execution

○ Flows and declarative automation

○ Bulk processing and data volume

○ Multi-tenant OEM applications

  • Deep Salesforce administrator-level expertise, including:

○ Flow and declarative automation tooling

○ Security and permissions modeling

○ Page layouts and Lightning Record Pages

○ Data modeling and configuration best practices

  • Experience using Git for source control in collaborative development environments
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data access patterns, and scalable design principles
  • Hold a Platform App Builder Certification is a valuable plus!


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build and scale advanced Salesforce OEM products that power multi-tenant enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

description:
Funcionário, Freelance, Contrato, Terceiro ou Temporário

Remoto, Híbrido ou Presencial

Mínimo 2 anos de experiência na área

Sobre a empresa

A COMTRAFO Indústria de Transformadores Elétricos S.A. é uma empresa brasileira especializada no projeto e fabricação de transformadores de potência para concessionárias e grandes projetos de energia no Brasil e no exterior.

A empresa integra o grupo American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) , companhia global de tecnologia energética sediada nos Estados Unidos, ampliando sua atuação internacional e capacidade de inovação.

Esse momento de expansão cria oportunidades de desenvolvimento técnico, crescimento profissional e participação em projetos de engenharia de alta complexidade no setor elétrico . ⚡

Descrição da vaga

A COMTRAFO Indústria de Transformadores Elétricos S.A. , empresa do grupo American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) , busca profissional para atuar como Projetista / Calculista Elétrico de Transformadores de Potência , integrando a área de Orçamentos e Engenharia de Vendas .

O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de estudos técnicos, dimensionamento e elaboração de propostas para transformadores de potência até 345 kV , destinados ao mercado nacional e internacional , atuando em interface com as áreas de engenharia, comercial e clientes.

Principais atividades:

  • Realizar dimensionamento de transformadores de potência (reatância, perdas, correntes, impedâncias, esforços de curto-circuito, etc.);
  • Elaborar memoriais de cálculo e folhas de dados técnicas para propostas;
  • Analisar especificações técnicas de clientes (ET / RFQ) e normas aplicáveis;
  • Definir configurações técnicas e construtivas dos equipamentos para atendimento às especificações;
  • Apoiar a área comercial na elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais ;
  • Interagir com clientes e equipes internas para esclarecimentos técnicos durante o processo de oferta ;
  • Participar da avaliação técnica de riscos e viabilidade de fornecimento .

Perfil desejado:

  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica ;
  • Conhecimento em transformadores de potência e seus princípios de projeto ;
  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas do setor (IEC / IEEE) ;
  • Capacidade de análise técnica, organização e comunicação com diferentes áreas;
  • Inglês técnico será considerado diferencial.

O profissional terá a oportunidade de atuar em projetos de engenharia para sistemas elétricos de alta complexidade , contribuindo para soluções destinadas a utilities e grandes projetos de energia no Brasil e no exterior . ⚡

Administrative Operations

• Prepare and manage buyer and seller documentation using the Compass platform

Listing & Deal Coordination

title: Project Control Analyst
description:
Responsibilities

  • Maintain and update project schedules, aligning baselines, deadlines, and deliverables.
  • Track budgets, financial forecasts, and cost/variance analysis.
  • Prepare consolidated reports on performance, cost, risk, and status.
  • Support Project Managers to ensure project processes run efficiently.
  • Reconcile invoices and ensure financial data integrity.
  • Monitor compliance with corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and governance.
  • Prepare analytical insights, trends, and indicators for leadership presentations.
  • Track documentation, changes, risks, and issues.
  • Use data proactively to highlight risks and support corrective actions.
  • Provide general PMO support, including data collection and reporting.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years in Project Coordination / PMO / Project Controls.
  • Experience with MS Project (preferred) and schedule management.
  • Strong analytical skills for working with budgets, cost control, and financial analysis.
  • Strong communication, organization, and stakeholder interaction skills.
  • Experience working with cross functional project teams.
  • Experience with change management and process monitoring.

title: Analista Servidores Pleno
description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!

Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Suporte de Servidores Pleno dedicado e proativo para se juntar à nossa equipe técnica. Se você está pronto para desenvolver sua carreira em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, aplicando seus conhecimentos em sistemas operacionais e cloud computing, esta é a sua chance!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Atuar na infraestrutura e administração de sistemas operacionais Windows Server, Linux
  • Atuar na infraestrutura de Vmware ESXi e Cloud AWS Azure GCP OCI
  • Identificar e implementar melhorias nos sistemas operacionais Windows Server e Linux;
  • Realizar mudanças em ambientes de produção, sempre sob supervisão, para garantir a estabilidade dos serviços;
  • Contribuir com as metas operacionais da equipe, mantendo os SLAs dos clientes;
  • Trabalhar diretamente com os clientes para analisar problemas e ajudar na definição de soluções eficazes.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Conhecimentos avançados em Sistemas Operacionais Windows Server, Linux, incluindo ambientes virtualizados Vmware
  • Administração de Active Directory, configuração de GPO (Group Policy Objects) e gerenciamento de WSUS (Windows Server Update Services);
  • Administração de serviços de rede, DNS (Domain Name System), DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) e DFS (Distributed File System);
  • Atualização de versão do sistema operacional Linux, Windows
  • Aplicação de Patches nos servidores.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de scripts em PowerShell;
  • Habilidade para administração do ambiente do Microsoft Active Directory e NPS;
  • Gestão de File Server, Print Server, Radius, Certificate Authority
  • Conhecimento em Cloud (AWS, GCP, OCI, Azure)

Diferenciais:

  • Possuir ou estar em processo de obtenção de certificações em Windows/Linux/Cloud (AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP);
  • Cursando ensino superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Idioma: Inglês Técnico

Informações sobre a Vaga:

  • Horário de trabalho: a definir
  • Localização: Hibrido São Paulo ou Londrina.

Benefícios:

Plano de saúde

Plano odontológico

Wellhub (Gympass)

Espaço Saúde - promove a saúde e bem-estar aos nossos colaboradores, dando suporte com atendimento médico ( presencial ou online) para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida.

Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

Vale transporte

Universidade corporativa (E-learning com diversos cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

Speexx (cursar até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

Convênio farmácias (descontos em medicamentos)

Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

Day off no seu aniversário

Programa de acompanhamento às gestantes (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras e cônjuges de colaboradores)

title: Analista Servidores Pleno
description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!

Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Suporte de Servidores Pleno dedicado e proativo para se juntar à nossa equipe técnica. Se você está pronto para desenvolver sua carreira em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, aplicando seus conhecimentos em sistemas operacionais e cloud computing, esta é a sua chance!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Atuar na infraestrutura e administração de sistemas operacionais Windows Server, Linux
  • Atuar na infraestrutura de Vmware ESXi e Cloud AWS Azure GCP OCI
  • Identificar e implementar melhorias nos sistemas operacionais Windows Server e Linux;
  • Realizar mudanças em ambientes de produção, sempre sob supervisão, para garantir a estabilidade dos serviços;
  • Contribuir com as metas operacionais da equipe, mantendo os SLAs dos clientes;
  • Trabalhar diretamente com os clientes para analisar problemas e ajudar na definição de soluções eficazes.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Conhecimentos avançados em Sistemas Operacionais Windows Server, Linux, incluindo ambientes virtualizados Vmware
  • Administração de Active Directory, configuração de GPO (Group Policy Objects) e gerenciamento de WSUS (Windows Server Update Services);
  • Administração de serviços de rede, DNS (Domain Name System), DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) e DFS (Distributed File System);
  • Atualização de versão do sistema operacional Linux, Windows
  • Aplicação de Patches nos servidores.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de scripts em PowerShell;
  • Habilidade para administração do ambiente do Microsoft Active Directory e NPS;
  • Gestão de File Server, Print Server, Radius, Certificate Authority
  • Conhecimento em Cloud (AWS, GCP, OCI, Azure)

Diferenciais:

  • Possuir ou estar em processo de obtenção de certificações em Windows/Linux/Cloud (AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP);
  • Cursando ensino superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação.

title: Desenvolvedor Java/ Springboot - Júnior
description:
Pessoa desenvolvedora Backend Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e serviços backend de alta qualidade e eficiência, utilizando Java e SpringBoot.
  • Colaborar com times de frontend e outros stakeholders para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos de negócio e técnicos.
  • Documentar as soluções e práticas adotadas no desenvolvimento.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java.
  • Conhecimento do framework SpringBoot e suas principais bibliotecas e módulos (Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring MVC, etc).
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL) e noSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.
  • Experiência com controle de versão, preferencialmente Git.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD (ex: Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços e em servidores de aplicação leve.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: React Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

Join our dynamic Team as a React Developer and drive innovation in a collaborative environment. You'll enhance services, tools, and components within a collaborative Team by driving Agile solutions for internal and external challenges, ensuring top-notch software quality. Become a key player in our Core team, utilizing modern technologies to shape artifacts and support diverse groups, all while ensuring our software reaches new heights of excellence.

Key responsibilities:

- Develop high-quality, maintainable, and scalable user interface components using React.js.

- Work closely with the product and design teams to achieve effective UX.

- Collaborate with other developers on tasks related to front-end and back-end services.

- Conduct performance optimization of applications for maximum speed and scalability.

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the latest React frameworks and libraries.

Requirements:

- 5+ years of experience in React.

- Experience with Typescript.

- Familiarity with caching systems.

- Comfortable working in GMT+2 timezone.

- Fluent Spanish level.

- Intermediate English level.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.

O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com Dados e AWS.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência avançada em AWS e seus principais serviços para engenharia de dados (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.).
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python para manipulação e processamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de orquestração de dados, como Apache Airflow ou AWS Step Functions.
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacional e não relacional (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados).
  • Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).
  • Conhecimento em controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub, Jenkins, ou CodePipeline.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.
