title: Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript / GraphQL)

Location: Remote – Brazil or Mexico

Employment Type: Contract

Interview Process: Internal Interview + Client Interview


Role Details

We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable cloudbased GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion processing and delivery system integrating streaming data and highperformance querying.


You’ll work closely with crossfunctional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the CBS Sports digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties
  • Help lead team members in the design development and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies daily standups grooming and sprint planning
  • Practice DevOps writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring
  • Review your teammates designs and code providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions including weekly deep dive sessions on various topics
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration


Key Projects

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products ingesting processing and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management


Qualifications

What you bring to the team

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development
  • Experience in designing implementing and maintaining GraphQL schemas optimizing query performance and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences
  • Experience with Javascript TypeScript Python Nodejs
  • Experience with relational NoSQL and keyvalue data stores such as Aurora MySQL DynamoDB MongoDB Redis
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloudbased environment AWS preferred with high transaction volumes using a variety of connected services
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies continuous integration unit testing and automated integration tests GitHub issue tracking tools Jira and CICD related disciplines GitOps
  • Ability to design solutions provide estimates and evaluate risk and technical feasibility
  • BS Computer Science Engineering a related technical degree or equivalent professional experience


You might also have

  • Wundergraph Cosmo or Apollo GraphQL experience
  • AWS Certifications
  • Experience with extract transform load ETL pipelines using data orchestration platforms cloud services and frameworks a plus
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering product and architecture
  • Energetic selfstarter who can work in a complex collaborative environment that rewards innovation initiative curiosity and mentoring
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming

title: Mid Back-End Data Engineer (.Net / C#)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Mid Back-End Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience and strong expertise in .NET and C#. This role focuses on ingesting and transforming data from multiple sources, running data validations, and ensuring high data quality across ETL pipelines and backend services. The ideal candidate has experience with APIs, legacy data migrations, and AWS-based data environments. Experience with ECS Fargate, SQS, Kinesis, Firehose, S3, and Apache Iceberg is a plus.

This project has a 3-6 month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.

Responsibilities

  • Receive and process raw data from multiple internal and legacy systems.
  • Design and implement data transformation pipelines that convert incoming data into standardized formats.
  • Develop and maintain .NET / C# services and APIs used for data ingestion and transformation.
  • Build and execute data validation and quality checks to ensure the reliability and accuracy of data pipelines.
  • Support ETL processes, including exporting data from legacy systems and integrating it into modern platforms.
  • Work closely with existing engineers responsible for data migration and integration efforts.
  • Act as a data quality advocate, focusing on validating and testing data flows rather than application UI or front-end functionality.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to improve data consistency, validation processes, and pipeline stability.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering roles.
  • Strong experience with .NET and C# development.
  • Experience developing APIs and backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, ETL processes, and data transformation.
  • Experience implementing data validation and data quality checks.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems or legacy platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS-based data infrastructure and services.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Python for data processing or scripting.
  • Experience working with Apache Iceberg tables for data lake management.
  • Experience with AWS data and streaming services, such as:
  • Amazon ECS Fargate
  • Amazon SQS
  • Amazon Kinesis
  • Amazon Kinesis Firehose
  • Amazon S3

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Overview of the role:

The Machine Learning and Data Science Specialist position focuses on serving as the owner of ML algorithms powering campaign segmentation and targeting systems. This role is central to product success, managing massive systems with millions of data points and ensuring models directly impact business outcomes while optimizing, supervising, and evolving ML pipelines to drive innovation and reliability in critical platform components.

Key responsibilities:

- Optimizing existing machine learning algorithms to improve accuracy and performance.

- Proposing, designing, and implementing new ML features that enhance product capabilities.

- Supervising and monitoring machine learning performance at scale.

- Defining ML requirements and collaborating with engineering and product personnel to bring them to life.

- Handling administrative and organizational duties related to ML initiatives.

Requirements:

- ML Experience: 5+ years of comprehensive experience in Machine Learning, including at least 4 years building end-to-end model development lifecycles (requirements definition, feature discovery, model training/registration, deployment, monitoring, and MLOps).

- Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python, with strong knowledge of data and ML frameworks.

- Statistical Foundation: Solid fundamentals in probability and statistics.

- Business Acumen: Business-minded approach with proven stakeholder management skills — able to define work based on conversations with senior leaders.

- Product Mindset: Product-oriented perspective: designing ML pipelines with direct business impact and thriving in ownership-heavy environments.

- Development Practices: Familiarity with development best practices and navigating complex production codebases.

- Education: Postgraduate degree in Machine Learning or Data Science.

Additional skills preferred:

- Databricks Platform: Experience with Databricks environment.

- ML Explainability: Experience implementing machine learning explainability pipelines.

- Orchestration Tools: Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.

- Marketing Applications: Experience applying machine learning to marketing use cases.

- Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Home Office Setup: Complete hardware provision for your workspace.

- Flexible Hours: Design your own work schedule for optimal work-life balance.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

The Machine Learning and Data Science Specialist position focuses on serving as the owner of ML algorithms powering campaign segmentation and targeting systems. This role is central to product success, managing massive systems with millions of data points and ensuring models directly impact business outcomes while optimizing, supervising, and evolving ML pipelines to drive innovation and reliability in critical platform components.

Key responsibilities:

- Optimizing existing machine learning algorithms to improve accuracy and performance.

- Proposing, designing, and implementing new ML features that enhance product capabilities.

- Supervising and monitoring machine learning performance at scale.

- Defining ML requirements and collaborating with engineering and product personnel to bring them to life.

- Handling administrative and organizational duties related to ML initiatives.

Requirements:

- ML Experience: 5+ years of comprehensive experience in Machine Learning, including at least 4 years building end-to-end model development lifecycles (requirements definition, feature discovery, model training/registration, deployment, monitoring, and MLOps).

- Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python, with strong knowledge of data and ML frameworks.

- Statistical Foundation: Solid fundamentals in probability and statistics.

- Business Acumen: Business-minded approach with proven stakeholder management skills — able to define work based on conversations with senior leaders.

- Product Mindset: Product-oriented perspective: designing ML pipelines with direct business impact and thriving in ownership-heavy environments.

- Development Practices: Familiarity with development best practices and navigating complex production codebases.

- Education: Postgraduate degree in Machine Learning or Data Science.

Additional skills preferred:

- Databricks Platform: Experience with Databricks environment.

- ML Explainability: Experience implementing machine learning explainability pipelines.

- Orchestration Tools: Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.

- Marketing Applications: Experience applying machine learning to marketing use cases.

What to expect from us:

- Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Home Office Setup: Complete hardware provision for your workspace.

- Flexible Hours: Design your own work schedule for optimal work-life balance.

- Paid Leave: PTO, parental leave, and other special leaves.

- Professional Development: English classes and Udemy for Business access.

- Financial Benefits: Personal loans with 0% interest following company policies.

- Competitive Compensation: Payment well above market average.

- Growth Opportunities: Develop at the speed of your learning curve.

- Innovation-Driven Environment: Support and resources for professional growth in diverse, multicultural environment.

- Game-Changing Opportunity: Resources to make significant impact in a fast-growing company.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, do not hesitate to apply!

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Community Manager
description:
Você vive futebol no dia a dia, acompanha tendências, transforma lances em conversa e sabe como criar interação real nas redes sociais? O Jogo a Jogo procura um(a) Community Manager para cuidar da relação com a nossa comunidade.

Falamos de esportes e apostas com uma linguagem leve, criativa e próxima do público brasileiro, sem abrir mão de informação, contexto e responsabilidade editorial. Procuramos alguém que saiba equilibrar resenha, timing e leitura de comunidade.

Devido à natureza do calendário esportivo, e em particular para a cobertura da Copa do Mundo durante o período da contratação, é desejável flexibilidade de horário para cobrir online os jogos que serão transmitidos da América do Norte (Canadá, EUA e México).

Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, gosta de futebol para além do placar e entende o valor de construir comunidade — queremos conhecer você.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar e publicar conteúdos diários para Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok e outras redes;
  • Monitorar menções e interagir com o público de forma criativa e respeitosa;
  • Estar atento(a) a trends, memes e momentos do futebol para gerar engajamento;
  • Colaborar com o time editorial para alinhar prognósticos, posts e campanhas;
  • Criar e redigir e-mails de marketing para a base de usuários do Apostas no IG ou em conjunto com os outros projetos e sites do grupo.
  • Acompanhar métricas e propor novas estratégias para aumentar o alcance.
  • Realizar a cobertura online da Copa do Mundo durante o período da contratação, incluindo interações e posts em tempo real sobre os jogos transmitidos da América do Norte (Canadá, EUA e México).

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia com social media ou community management;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas gráficas (Adobe photoshop,Illustrator etc) e edição de vídeo (Capcut,Riverside, After Effects etc);
  • Fluência em português brasileiro (conteúdo voltado para o público do Brasil);
  • Paixão por esportes, especialmente futebol;
  • Escrita criativa e ágil, com domínio de linguagem digital;
  • Organização para lidar com demandas rápidas e calendário editorial;
  • Noções de métricas e ferramentas de gerenciamento de redes sociais e CRM (Hubspot, RD Station, Optimove etc);
  • Disponibilidade e flexibilidade de horário para cobrir eventos e jogos online, em especial durante a Copa do Mundo.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência na gestão de perfis de humor ou entretenimento esportivo;
  • Habilidade para criar memes, reels ou vídeos curtos;
  • Conhecimento de SEO e tendências do universo esportivo online.

Local de Trabalho

Híbrido para quem morar em Porto, Portugal. Remoto para demais localidades.

Modelo de Contratação

Contratação Pessoa Jurídica / MEI

Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se pelo botão do LinkedIn.

Se tiver dúvidas e/ou quiser enviar portfólio adicional, escreva para:

title: Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior
description:
Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior

Local: Fazenda Brasileiro – Teofilândia (BA), Brasil

Quantidade de Vagas: 01

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial

Disponibilidade: Mudança para a região (empresa oferece suporte)

Sobre a Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior para atuar na mina subterrânea , sendo responsável pelo planejamento estratégico e gestão do sistema de ventilação , bem como pelo acompanhamento de sua execução junto à equipe de Infraestrutura, assegurando condições adequadas de qualidade do ar, segurança operacional, conformidade legal e suporte eficiente às atividades de lavra e desenvolvimento da mina.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir a estratégia de ventilação da mina subterrânea, garantindo alinhamento ao plano de negócios, à segurança dos trabalhadores e à sustentabilidade da operação;
  • Desenvolver e revisar projetos de ventilação para mina subterrânea (primária e secundária);
  • Realizar estudos de fluxo de ar, controle de gases, poeiras, temperatura e umidade;
  • Dimensionar ventiladores principais e auxiliares, dutos, portas e reguladores de ventilação;
  • Elaborar e manter atualizados os planos de ventilação da mina;
  • Propor e implementar inovações, melhorias tecnológicas e iniciativas de otimização de custos nos sistemas de ventilação, visando ganhos de produtividade, segurança e sustentabilidade;
  • Analisar riscos críticos relacionados à ventilação, gases, particulados e condições ambientais, apoiando a gestão de riscos operacionais e a tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com geologia, planejamento de mina, produção, manutenção e SSMA;
  • Liderar estudos avançados de ventilação e projetos associados à expansão, aprofundamento ou mudanças de layout da mina, viabilizando tecnicamente novos cenários operacionais com segurança e eficiência.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação Completa em Engenharia;
  • Experiência sólida em ventilação de minas subterrâneas;
  • Vivência com softwares de ventilação (ex.: Ventsim, VentSim Design, VUMA ou similares);
  • Disponibilidade de mudança para Teofilândia, BA;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Ventilação de Minas, Segurança do Trabalho (desejável).

Se você tem interesse em ventilação de mina subterrânea, planejamento e controle da qualidade do ar, atuação em campo e liderança de equipes em um ambiente operacional dinâmico, essa vaga pode ser para você!

title: Career Framework Specialist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cut-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the Role:

The Career Framework Specialist plays a crucial role in designing and maintaining organizational talent structures, translating complex role dynamics into clear, scalable career paths. You'll bring clarity to organizational complexity by crafting intuitive job architectures that support talent growth and alignment.

Key Responsibilities:

- Designing and maintaining career paths, leveling frameworks, and job families for Talent roles.

- Building and updating role definitions, responsibilities, and seniority distinctions.

- Ensuring consistency, clarity, and scalability across all Talent-related structures.

- Partnering with Talent Acquisition Leaders to align role frameworks with business needs.

- Documenting and communicating updates in a clear, structured, and globally usable way.

- Supporting audits and Talent processes by keeping role architectures accurate and standardized.

Requirements:

- Experience: 3+ years in Organizational Development, Talent Management, HR Business Analysis, or Job Architecture.

- Design Skills: Proven experience designing career paths, job families, or role architectures.

- Analytical Ability: Strong capability to analyze and structure information into clear frameworks.

- Communication: Excellent written communication and documentation skills.

- Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional HR or Talent teams.

- Technical Skills: Advanced experience with Excel/Google Sheets and documentation tools.

Desired Tools Experience:

- Documentation platforms like Notion or Confluence.

- Flowchart/mapping tools such as Miro or Lucidchart.

Personal Attributes:

- Systems and structural thinking.

- Passion for clarity and logical problem-solving.

- Ability to translate complex information into intuitive frameworks.

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

- Skill in collaborating across multiple stakeholders.

What to Expect from Us:

- Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Competitive Compensation: Excellent payment in USD or your preferred local currency.

- Home Office Setup: Complete hardware provision for your workspace.

- Flexible Hours: Design your own work schedule for optimal work-life balance.

- Paid Leave: Parental leave, vacation, and national holidays.

- Dynamic Work Culture: Innovative and multicultural environment.

- Elite Collaboration: Work with the global top 1% of talent.

- Growth and Support: Mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, do not hesitate to apply!

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior AI Engineer - RAG & MCP (Integrations & Tools)
description:
Remote | Full-time | Voiceflip

Employee located in South America prefered.

Salary $1,200-2,000 usd / month

We’re hiring a senior AI engineer to own RAG systems, MCP, and tool integrations for ARDI — our production AI assistants used by real estate associations and MLSs across North America.

This role is for someone who enjoys turning messy data + APIs into reliable AI tools.

Not prompt hacking. Not research.

What you’ll do

  • Build and improve production RAG pipelines
  • Design and operate MCP servers and tools
  • Connect ARDI to new APIs, datasets, and systems
  • Improve grounding, retrieval accuracy, and trust
  • Debug hallucinations by fixing retrieval and context
  • Work closely with product and customers on real use cases

What we’re looking for

  • Strong hands-on experience with RAG systems
  • Real experience with MCP and tool orchestration
  • Python in production environments
  • Vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
  • Experience with ingestion pipelines and unstructured data
  • Senior-level judgment: you know why things break

Nice to have

  • Azure or cloud-native deployments
  • AI agents / multi-tool systems
  • Search, IR, or NLP background
  • Enterprise or regulated data experience

Why this role

  • Small, senior team
  • Real product-market fit
  • You’ll shape the architecture, not inherit chaos
  • Focus on accuracy, accessibility, and trust

title: Human Resources Business Partner Manager (HRBP)
description:
Who we are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we’re on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With innovation and technology at our core, Keeta is expanding rapidly — with over 1,000 employees worldwide — and you can be part of this global journey.

About the position

We are looking for a HRBP Manager to join our HR team in Brazil .

You will report directly to the HR Lead in Brazil and collaborate with a lean, high-impact team responsible for different business lines and strategic projects.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone comfortable operating in high-growth, 0→1 environments , balancing strategy, execution, and stakeholder management.

Job Responsibilities:

Organizational Optimization:

  • Assist business leaders in building an efficient organizational structure for Keeta, facilitating alignment of goals within the management team.
  • Regularly conduct organizational diagnostics to identify key issues and challenges, and proactively follow up on solutions.

Talent Development:

  • Utilize talent review, development, and co-creation facilitation methods to focus on the recruitment, training, development, and advancement of key talents.
  • Provide strong talent pipeline support and help build talent succession plans for business departments.

Culture Implementation:

  • Drive the implementation and promotion of corporate culture and values within the department.
  • Regularly organize employee engagement and care activities to communicate company philosophy and values, strengthening team cohesion and morale.

Strategic Partnership:

  • Gain deep understanding of the business strategy of the international team.
  • Participate in the entire process from strategy formulation to execution, and develop tailored HR plans to achieve both short- and long-term business objectives.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 3 years of HR experience; experience supporting international teams is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate efficiently with international teams and partners.
  • Strong logical thinking and learning ability, solid HR fundamentals, self-driven, curious, and able to work under pressure.

Job Highlights:

  • Opportunity to participate in the building of an international team, broaden your horizons, and work with global talent.
  • Fast-growing business with great personal development potential; work alongside a professional and high-caliber HR team.

Nice to have

  • Experience working in Chinese companies or multicultural, Asia-influenced environments.

Interested in joining Keeta?

Check out our open positions! When applying, your information will be securely stored and may be shared with Keeta and its global affiliates.

title: OIC Engineer
description:
Job Title: OIC Engineer

Location: Remote - Brazil

Duration: 12+ Months


Skills:

  • OIC VBCS platform expertise
  • Java – Expert level
  • JavaScript – Expert Level
  • TRADACOM, EDIFACT, X12 – Expert
  • Experience with EDI Integrations on OIC is an Essential skill
  • Experience with SFTP and AS2 based EDI



Job Description

  • Analyze systems integrations and creates systems and software architecture that keep enterprise data secure and compliant.
  • Uses standards and best practices to create architectural designs and diagrams.
  • Interfaces with clients and business partners to understand the overall needs.
  • Create Integration processes using OIC technologies.
  • Build reusable code. Build efficiently upon the existing data model and quickly change gears as priorities change.
  • Maintain high service levels for clients, always on Implement security and data protection.
  • Design and implement data storage solutions.
  • Estimate work effort and assist with task breakdowns.
  • Document work via appropriate code comments as well as maintain complete and detailed diagrams of the work being done.
  • Collaborate with team in solving complex problems, while at same time work independently on assigned tasks.
  • Follow, enhance, and contribute to group coding standards and best practices around documentation, code.
  • formatting, source-control.
  • Ability to assist business users to get familiarity with OIC (error log checking, OIC dashboards, examining payloads for errors, etc).

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

You will lead a team of 4–7 professionals and work closely with leadership, auditors, and international stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close under BR GAAP and US GAAP
  • Manage intercompany consolidation , eliminations, and reconciliations
  • Oversee the Brazilian tax operation , including direct and indirect tax calculations and statutory filings (SPED, ECF, ECD, etc.)
  • Coordinate the U.S. tax operation with external advisors
  • Manage transfer pricing processes between group entities
  • Lead the external audit process and act as the main point of contact with Big Four auditors
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements within NetSuite
  • Explore the use of AI and automation tools to improve reconciliations, financial close, and variance analysis
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Accounting & Tax team
  • Provide financial insights and reporting to support leadership decision-making

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)
  • 5+ years of corporate experience after Big Four, ideally in high-growth or technology companies
  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S. teams and auditors)
  • Experience leading and developing accounting or tax teams

Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)
  • Familiarity with tax automation tools
  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes
  • Experience optimizing NetSuite workflows, scripts, or dashboards
  • Postgraduate degree or certifications such as CPA or MBA in Finance

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to challenge manual processes and drive improvements
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex technical topics to leadership
  • Interest in technology, automation, and innovation within finance

title: Sr. Procurement Analyst -80% Spanish
description:
About the Job


Sr. Procurement Analyst will execute and manage Indirect spend categories' strategic sourcing and procurement across all supply chain operations facility types agreed to be in-scope and will deliver business requirements providing the best value to key business stakeholders.The focus will be managing the end-to-end strategic sourcing process and all in-scope elements of indirect spend for LATAM with emphasis on Brazil and the rest of the countries of South America (not limited).


Scope: Regions: Americas (subregion: LATAM)


Languages : Portuguese and Spanish 90%


Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with regional and global procurement priorities, leveraging market analysis to optimize supplier selection and performance.
  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including negotiating contracts, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities within assigned categories to meet annual savings targets and drive value for the business.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs and ensure early involvement in the sourcing process.
  • Monitor supplier performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and address gaps to improve quality, delivery, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure procurement activities adhere to governance, ethical sourcing practices, and sustainability objectives while supporting audit and compliance requirements.
  • Provide regular reporting and analytics on procurement performance, including spend analysis, cost savings, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with global category managers and cross-functional teams to leverage scale, align strategies, and drive procurement initiatives effectively.

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred (Business, Supply Chain, or Engineering).

  • Strong supplier segmentation, supplier performance and relationship management

description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Estamos buscando um Analista Inteligência em projetos de IA e Data Science para atuação em cliente Atos.


Cientista de Dados Sênior com experiência comprovada em projetos de IA aplicada, inglês avançado (no mínimo para compreensão de leitura e audição), capacidade de liderar projetos de forma independente e experiência no desenvolvimento e supervisão de atividades em todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de IA (do pré-processamento de dados à implantação em produção).

Experiência desenvolvendo projetos com IA Generativa,

Experiência com projetos em ambiente de nuvem,

Habilidades de programação avançadas em Python, SQL e NoSQL


Atuação remota.

Programa de acompanhamento às gestantes (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras e cônjuges de colaboradores)

title: Mainframe System Engineer
description:
Mainframe System Engineer

Location – Brazil Remote



Job Overview:


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Mandatory Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:
  • IBM OMEGAMON for Storage
  • IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm
  • IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)
  • IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)
  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems
  • CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).
  • CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).
  • IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation, operational considerations).
  • CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Project Description:

  • The Anaplan Technical Lead is an experienced multi-skilled professional with hands-on experience in Anaplan model development/Support experience. He/she is a good team player who is part of a team responsible for delivering end-to-end application development and Operations Support.


Responsibilities:

  • • Troubleshoot and provide solutions, Root Cause Analysis for incidents raised by business users/L1 team.
  • • Troubleshoot issues related to application access, process, scripts, etc.
  • • Handles Anaplan planned downtimes individually.
  • • In case of incident with a product quality issue, ensure PR is created and tagged against the incident before closing it.
  • • Perform UAT testing for projects owned by operations like new market adoption, simple logic change, etc.
  • • Prepare, present changes in change advisory board and own production implementation.
  • • Coordinate and manage discussions with other support teams and business users.
  • • Effectively communicate with stakeholders and business users.
  • • Think creatively to solve the user problem with a holistic and simple solution.
  • • Drive best practices within teams with respect to operations standards and guidelines.
  • • Ability to learn and adapt to new frameworks/technologies.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Should have strong knowledge of Anaplan Connect, ALM Sync, NUX and Cloudworks.
  • • Anaplan Professional Model Builder / Professional Solution Architect Certified.
  • • Should have strong knowledge of troubleshooting and resolving incidents raised by business users and L1 Support.
  • • Good knowledge of troubleshooting and fixing job execution failures.
  • • Ability to analyse /root cause the PRs created for the Anaplan support models.
  • • Prior work experience in Anaplan Support projects.
  • Availability to work in US Central Time
  • Availability to regularly travel to St. Louis
  • • Good communication skills.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • • Basic knowledge of Cloud Services
  • • Knowledge in SRE, ITIL, AgileOps
  • • Able to work independently and interact with the business community, L3 team to come up with solutions.
  • • Knowledge of testing tools like Playwright / Selenium.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | Data Engineering & GenAI (GCP)
description:
Sobre a vaga:


Operamos em duas frentes: a Plataforma Unificada de Pessoas, voltada a People Analytics e diagnóstico organizacional, e projetos de consultoria estratégica baseados em dados para grandes marcas globais. No lado de consultoria, construímos plataformas de analytics, modelos preditivos e camadas de IA generativa que alimentam decisões comerciais de alto nível, incluindo projetos para CPGs com presença em toda a América Latina.


Estamos contratando um(a) profissional sênior para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, modelagem e IA em produção. O escopo é amplo por design: somos pequenos. Não há um engenheiro dedicado só a pipelines e outro só a modelagem. Você faz os dois, e precisa saber quando priorizar cada frente. O trabalho de consultoria é concreto: pegar dados de múltiplas fontes (sell-in, sell-out, P&L, market share, distribuição), estruturar pipelines que não quebrem toda semana, construir modelos que vão para produção de verdade, e desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa sobre esses dados. A plataforma interna de People Analytics caminha em paralelo, com modelagem de diagnóstico organizacional e integração de LLMs nos fluxos de produto.



Responsabilidades:


  • Estruturar e orquestrar pipelines de dados (BigQuery, GCP) com monitoramento real;
  • Harmonizar múltiplas fontes com nomenclaturas inconsistentes e atualizações diárias;
  • Construir modelos preditivos (XGBoost/LightGBM) e simuladores de cenário;
  • Colocar ML em produção: APIs (FastAPI), versionamento (MLflow, DVC), monitoramento de drift;
  • Desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa usando RAG, Vertex AI e LangChain;
  • Trabalhar direto com produto, tech lead e fundador — e eventualmente apresentar resultados para executivos de clientes globais.



Requisitos:


  • Superior completo em Ciência da computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de software ou áreas afins;
  • Python sólido e SQL avançado;
  • GCP na prática: BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud Run;
  • Orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect ou similar) — não só saber o que é, mas ter feito;
  • ML em produção de verdade, não apenas notebooks;
  • Familiaridade com LLMs, RAG e LangChain;
  • Experiência com Metabase ou ferramenta de BI equivalente para entrega de insights a stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura técnica, documentação e contexto com clientes;
  • Perfil autônomo: sabe definir própria agenda dentro de objetivos claros.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)

Location: Brazil

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.

Position Overview

As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.

Competencies / Requirements

  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Desenvolvedor PHP Pleno
description:
Oportunidade 100% Remoto e PJ

Estamos buscando desenvolvedores(as) de sistemas/aplicações Web, para colaborar na construção de aplicativos seguros, escaláveis e de alto desempenho. O profissional atuará no ciclo de desenvolvimento completo de projetos existentes e novos projetos, desde a sua conceituação (escopo, analise, entendimento), desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos Web eficientes, tanto para a execução no servidor como nos browsers, com possibilidades de instalação na nuvem;

  • Executar as atividades de todas as fases do ciclo do desenvolvimento e implantação dos aplicativos, usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Colaborar na definição da solução técnica aos requisitos de negócio, junto a área de produtos e junto aos clientes, implementando-a de forma eficiente e eficaz;
  • Criar códigos bem projetados, testáveis, eficientes, seguros e aderentes às necessidades de negócio e com a arquitetura de referência corporativa;
  • Desenvolver garantindo a qualidade e a manutenibilidade do código, zelando por sua documentação e projetando/executando testes unitários e de integração;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de desenvolvimento, atuando como replicador de conhecimento e das boas práticas corporativas.
  • Proatividade, ética e senso de ownership para assumir responsabilidades, entregar resultados consistentes e colaborar ativamente para o sucesso do time e dos projetos.
  • Compromisso com a qualidade, garantindo entregas consistentes e sem retrabalho, avaliando alternativas para cada situação e mantendo altos padrões mesmo sob pressão ou prazos desafiadores.
  • Foco em resultados, garantindo entregas de alto impacto, superando desafios e agregando valor de forma consistente, mesmo em condições desafiadoras.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Graduação Completa em Engenharia de Software, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia (outras especialidades), Matemática ou Física;

  • Experiência avançada em desenvolvimento de aplicação Web (Web App) de alta performance;
  • Experiência avançada com PHP;
  • Experiência com frameworks de mercado (Laravel, Zend ou Symfony);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JQuery, JavaScript, ReactJS;
  • Experiência na aplicação de arquitetura para projetos PHP e \"design patterns\";
  • Experiência avançada em base de dados (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL e MongoDB);
  • Experiência com Github
  • Experiência com as seguintes aplicações KeyCloak, RabittMQ Docker, DBEaver, MailHog, entre outras
  • Experiência ambientes Linux / Apache
  • OOP, Web Services, APIs Restfull, XML, SOA;
  • Sistema de Filas/Mensagerias (RabbitMQ);
  • Serviços em Nuvem AWS, GCP e Azure;
  • Experiência com qualidade de codificação e boas práticas tais como: testes unitários.
  • Conhecimento/participação de processos ágeis de desenvolvimento com experiência em metodologia ágil Scrum, XP, Agile.
  • Protagonismo (autodidata, assumir desafios, engajado) e capacidade de trabalho em equipes auto gerenciáveis.
  • Uso de assistentes de IA para codificação (ex: SuperMaven, Copilot, Gemini, OpenIA, Vercel AI, Lhama, Claude);

Requisitos e qualificações:

Certificações nos ambientes, e tecnologias descritas anteriormente

  • Conhecimento de outras linguagens (Java, Python)
  • Certificações web, qualidade de código, metodologia ágeis, etc

Estamos buscando desenvolvedores(as) de sistemas/aplicações Web, para colaborar na construção de aplicativos seguros, escaláveis e de alto desempenho. O profissional atuará no ciclo de desenvolvimento completo de projetos existentes e novos projetos, desde a sua conceituação (escopo, analise, entendimento), desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos Web eficientes, tanto para a execução no servidor como nos browsers, com possibilidades de instalação na nuvem;

  • Executar as atividades de todas as fases do ciclo do desenvolvimento e implantação dos aplicativos, usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Colaborar na definição da solução técnica aos requisitos de negócio, junto a área de produtos e junto aos clientes, implementando-a de forma eficiente e eficaz;
  • Criar códigos bem projetados, testáveis, eficientes, seguros e aderentes às necessidades de negócio e com a arquitetura de referência corporativa;
  • Desenvolver garantindo a qualidade e a manutenibilidade do código, zelando por sua documentação e projetando/executando testes unitários e de integração;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de desenvolvimento, atuando como replicador de conhecimento e das boas práticas corporativas.
  • Proatividade, ética e senso de ownership para assumir responsabilidades, entregar resultados consistentes e colaborar ativamente para o sucesso do time e dos projetos.
  • Compromisso com a qualidade, garantindo entregas consistentes e sem retrabalho, avaliando alternativas para cada situação e mantendo altos padrões mesmo sob pressão ou prazos desafiadores.
  • Foco em resultados, garantindo entregas de alto impacto, superando desafios e agregando valor de forma consistente, mesmo em condições desafiadoras.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Graduação Completa em Engenharia de Software, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia (outras especialidades), Matemática ou Física;

  • Experiência avançada em desenvolvimento de aplicação Web (Web App) de alta performance;
  • Experiência avançada com PHP;
  • Experiência com frameworks de mercado (Laravel, Zend ou Symfony);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JQuery, JavaScript, ReactJS;
  • Experiência na aplicação de arquitetura para projetos PHP e \"design patterns\";
  • Experiência avançada em base de dados (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL e MongoDB);
  • Experiência com Github
  • Experiência com as seguintes aplicações KeyCloak, RabittMQ Docker, DBEaver, MailHog, entre outras
  • Experiência ambientes Linux / Apache
  • OOP, Web Services, APIs Restfull, XML, SOA;
  • Sistema de Filas/Mensagerias (RabbitMQ);
  • Serviços em Nuvem AWS, GCP e Azure;
  • Experiência com qualidade de codificação e boas práticas tais como: testes unitários.
  • Conhecimento/participação de processos ágeis de desenvolvimento com experiência em metodologia ágil Scrum, XP, Agile.
  • Protagonismo (autodidata, assumir desafios, engajado) e capacidade de trabalho em equipes auto gerenciáveis.
  • Uso de assistentes de IA para codificação (ex: SuperMaven, Copilot, Gemini, OpenIA, Vercel AI, Lhama, Claude);

Requisitos e qualificações:

Certificações nos ambientes, e tecnologias descritas anteriormente

  • Conhecimento de outras linguagens (Java, Python)
  • Certificações web, qualidade de código, metodologia ágeis, etc

title: Refunds Specialist
description:
ROLE

Property Leads is a fast-growing startup building cutting-edge lead generation and data solutions for the real estate industry. We're a lean, high-impact team of 20, solving complex problems at the intersection of technology, data, and growth.


We’re looking for an exceptional communicator and  lead prospector capable of achieving remarkable results in the Refunds Specialist role at Property Leads. The successful candidate in this role must know that this is not a traditional 9 am to 5 pm job– evening and weekend work are required, and 40-60 hours per week are required.


You’ll work closely with our Senior Refund Coordinator and Customer Success Manager to collect data through text, phone calls, and email communication to process refunds accurately and efficiently.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to confirm the status of selling their home.
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to determine if they own the home.
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to confirm if a mobile home for sale does/does not come with the land it sits on.
  • Move all prospects to the proper pipeline stage via CRM throughout the day.
  • Maintain a clear, up-to-date, and accurate pipeline in our CRM.
  • Follow up diligently and consistently with sellers over extended periods.
  • Document all interactions with prospects and clients in the CRM's “notes” section, escalating to Support or the Senior Refunds Coordinator as needed.
  • Process refunds with integrity, according to the refund policy.


RESULTS

  • Reach sellers promptly to help determine the outcome of declining/approving a refund request.
  • All sellers are promptly followed up with.
  • There is an effective line of communication between this role and the Senior Refunds Coordinator in which all necessary information is communicated promptly.
  • Continuously improve communication skills (Crucial Conversations book, etc.)
  • All internal communication cycles are adequately followed.


REQUIREMENTS

  • Proven work experience with cold calling or phone sales.
  • Proven work experience with text messaging/emailing in English.
  • You must enjoy being on the phone and speaking to sellers.
  • Excellent communication skills, including listening and facing conflict head-on.
  • Excellent at building rapport.
  • Willing to work in a fast-paced environment and rapidly grow.
  • Open to learning new processes in cold calling/seller outreach.
  • Self-sufficient and able to properly manage one’s own time.
  • Well-organized and able to maintain a pipeline that the Refunds Coordinator and sales Manager can observe and understand.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Experience as a real estate investor is preferred  but optional.
  • Must pass written and verbal exams.

title: iOS Engineer (Swift)
description:
Salary: 55 LPA INR


Position Overview – Senior iOS Engineer

We are seeking experienced iOS engineers who enjoy working closely with cross‑functional teams and who bring strong architectural thinking, product sensibility, and a deep understanding of modern iOS development.

This role involves supporting a large and diverse user base, evolving the mobile application with new features, and ensuring high performance and quality across devices.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to plan, design, and deliver new application features.
  • Work together with backend/API developers and other mobile engineers to maintain a scalable, reliable, and well‑structured app ecosystem.
  • Continuously explore new iOS technologies and propose improvements to enhance product quality and user experience.
  • Participate in code reviews, refine development processes, and contribute to technical decision‑making.
  • Improve workflows, documentation, and collaboration practices within the engineering team.
  • Stay current with iOS platform changes and apply best practices to ongoing development.

Mandatory Requirements

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 6+ years of iOS development experience using Swift .
  • Minimum 1 year of hands‑on development using SwiftUI .
  • Deep understanding of modern iOS features and platform best practices.
  • Experience working with mid‑complexity mobile architectures (e.g., MVVM , VIPER , Clean Architecture , etc.).
  • Experience with mobile CI/CD platforms such as Bitrise or Jenkins.
  • Solid understanding of software design principles (e.g., SOLID , design patterns).
  • Familiarity with automated mobile testing (Unit, UI, Smoke Testing, etc.).
  • Strong communication skills, empathy, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Motivated to work in a team‑based product environment.
  • Strong sense of UX, attention to detail, and focus on usability.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with reactive programming frameworks.
  • Familiarity with test-driven development (TDD) or behavior-driven development (BDD).
  • Knowledge of performance profiling, debugging, and optimization on iOS.
  • Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation and guidelines.
  • Experience in travel‑related products or services.

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Company Description

Scandinavian Capital Markets is a foreign currency broker based in Stockholm with a remote workforce. We are building the next generation of currency trading technology and products, and we are looking for someone who can work independently and think outside the box. If you are someone who excels at mobile technologies, but also wants to have a voice in high-level decisions such as architecture and product, we want to meet you!


Role Description

We are looking for a sharp, independent engineer to join our team as a Fullstack Mobile Developer. You will work directly with our core team to build, optimize, and scale the mobile applications driving our product. This is a fully remote position.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Design and build robust backend APIs (e.g., Node.js, TypeScript, or Python) to support real-time mobile features.
  • Implement secure, seamless user interfaces (UI/UX) for complex financial dashboards and trading screens.
  • Handle real-time market data streams by integrating WebSockets and optimizing app state management.


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in React Native, JavaScript, and TypeScript. (must)
  • Solid backend experience (Node.js, Python, or similar) and familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Bonus: Experience with financial markets, fintech apps, or secure payment gateways.

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Company Description

Scandinavian Capital Markets is a foreign currency broker based in Stockholm with a remote workforce. We are building the next generation of currency trading technology and products, and we are looking for someone who can work independently and think outside the box. If you are someone who excels at mobile technologies, but also wants to have a voice in high-level decisions such as architecture and product, we want to meet you!


Role Description

We are looking for a sharp, independent engineer to join our team as a Fullstack Mobile Developer. You will work directly with our core team to build, optimize, and scale the mobile applications driving our product. This is a fully remote position.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Design and build robust backend APIs (e.g., Node.js, TypeScript, or Python) to support real-time mobile features.
  • Implement secure, seamless user interfaces (UI/UX) for complex financial dashboards and trading screens.
  • Handle real-time market data streams by integrating WebSockets and optimizing app state management.


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in React Native, JavaScript, and TypeScript. (must)
  • Solid backend experience (Node.js, Python, or similar) and familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Bonus: Experience with financial markets, fintech apps, or secure payment gateways.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Engineer

Location: Remote – Brazil

Mode: Contract

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Node.js and TypeScript, combined with experience in data engineering, database management, and data modeling. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize scalable data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and optimize backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.

• Design, implement, and maintain databases and data pipelines.

• Perform data modeling, data transformation, and integration between systems.

• Collaborate with data architects, analysts, and software engineers to ensure high-quality data solutions.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize data workflows for performance and scalability.

• Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards.

Required Skills & Experience

• 6+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript.

• Hands-on experience with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and data modeling.

• Strong understanding of APIs, backend architecture, and data integration patterns.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Excellent communication skills in English or Portuguese.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with ETL pipelines and data warehousing solutions.

• Familiarity with GraphQL or REST API development.

• Knowledge of data governance, data security, and compliance.

title: Python Developer
description:
Position: Python Engineer

Location: Remote in Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, or Costa Rica


Must Haves:

  • Expert-level Python (microservices, APIs, async patterns, testing)
  • Strong experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems patterns
  • Experience working with Databricks platform, using it to run Spark jobs, notebooks, etc.
  • Experience with Spark / Spark Streaming for batch + streaming jobs
  • Experience with Kafka and streaming/event-based integrations; familiarity with Avro schemas
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and data-driven applications Cloud experience in GCP and/or Azure Experience with containerization

Day-To-Day:

  • Design and develop Python-based microservices (REST/async services) with strong API contracts and clean service boundaries
  • Build and integrate event-driven services using the Kafka ecosystem (including Kafka Streams concepts where applicable) and schema-based messaging (Avro)
  • Implement batch and streaming workloads that support downstream systems (Spark / Spark Streaming), leveraging Databricks for job execution and notebooks when needed
  • Collaborate with product and engineering partners to evaluate architecture, define requirements, and deliver scalable features

title: Senior AI Engineer – Developer Productivity & AI in SDLC
description:
Estamos em busca de profissionais Senior AI Engineer – Developer Productivity & AI in SDLC para apoiar a construção e operacionalização do modelo de uso de Inteligência Artificial dentro do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC) .

Você atuará próximos da liderança de engenharia, ajudando a transformar estratégia em execução prática, estruturando padrões, playbooks e fluxos operacionais que permitam escalar o uso de IA entre squads de desenvolvimento.

Nosso foco está em engenharia aplicada, produtividade, adoção real e escala dentro do ambiente de desenvolvimento .

Se você gosta de transformar ideias em frameworks operacionais que funcionam no dia a dia das squads , essa oportunidade pode ser para você.


Missão da função

Apoiar a implementação do modelo operacional de uso de IA no SDLC , estruturando e executando iniciativas relacionadas a:

  • Uso de IA nas etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento
  • Melhoria da produtividade de engenharia
  • Criação de padrões, playbooks e frameworks internos
  • Enablement de squads de engenharia
  • Governança prática do uso de IA
  • Evolução contínua do processo


Principais responsabilidades

Apoiar o desenho e a evolução do modelo operacional de IA aplicado ao SDLC

Identificar oportunidades de uso de IA nas diferentes etapas do desenvolvimento

Criar playbooks, templates, padrões e ativos reutilizáveis

Apoiar squads piloto e escalar boas práticas para outras equipes

Colaborar na definição de uso de copilots, prompts, agent skills, workflows e automações

Mapear gargalos no fluxo atual de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias práticas

Consolidar aprendizados e transformá-los em padrões operacionais

  • Apoiar documentação, enablement e comunicação com times de engenharia
  • Atuar com autonomia na condução de iniciativas estratégicas


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência em software engineering, developer productivity, DevEx, platform engineering ou engenharia de software em escala.
  • Boa visão de SDLC real em ambientes corporativos
  • Capacidade de transformar diretrizes estratégicas em execução prática
  • Experiência colaborando com desenvolvedores, tech leads, arquitetura, QA e segurança
  • Perfil organizado, pragmático e colaborativo
  • Forte senso de ownership e entrega

title: Archer System Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Estamos em busca de um(a) System Engineer Sênior com experiência em ARCHER e ambientes Cloud (Azure e AWS) , para atuar no planejamento, engenharia e sustentação da infraestrutura de sistemas da organização.

O(a) profissional será responsável por upgrades, versionamentos, rotinas de manutenção e por garantir a estabilidade, performance e evolução dos ambientes tecnológicos.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Archer IT Controls Engineer dentro do modelo de governança de risk management.
  • Realizar manutenções, ajustes e criação de novos módulos dentro da plataforma Archer.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas de tecnologia e governança.
  • Trabalhar com alto nível de autonomia e organização.
  • Atuar em ambientes cloud (principalmente AWS) e apoiar rotinas de infraestrutura.


O que você precisa ter

  • Conhecimento avançado em RSA Archer (criação, customização e manutenção de módulos).
  • Forte background de infraestrutura .
  • AWS – indispensável (principal ambiente utilizado).
  • Azure – conhecimento desejável .
  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos de sistemas, redes e comunicação.
  • Vivência com upgrades, versionamento e rotinas de manutenção.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em SQL e bancos de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas corporativas (Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Power BI ).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de desenvolvimento e CI/CD (GitHub, PowerShell, JavaScript, .NET ) e com gestão de mudanças (ITIL) .

title: Business Analyst Salesforce - 131517
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional que atue com (Business Analyst Salesforce).

Responsabilidades:

Esteira de Melhoria de Service Cloud e Digital Engagement atendendo implementações legadas.

O Salesforce Business Analyst será responsável por conduzir o levantamento, análise e detalhamento de requisitos de negócio para soluções na plataforma Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud e Digital Engagement.

Atua como ponte estratégica entre negócio, tecnologia e times de desenvolvimento, garantindo que os requisitos sejam claros, priorizados e traduzidos em soluções aderentes às necessidades do cliente.

  • Conduzir workshops de discovery e levantamento de requisitos com stakeholders;
  • Elaborar requisitos funcionais, histórias de usuário e documentação funcional;
  • Definir critérios de aceite claros e testáveis;
  • Atuar na tradução das necessidades de negócio para soluções na plataforma Salesforce;
  • Participar da definição de soluções funcionais em Service Cloud;
  • Apoiar a implementação de Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp e Bots);
  • Definir e documentar regras de Omni-Channel Routing, filas, SLAs e roteamento;
  • Elaborar modelagem de dados funcional (objetos, campos e relacionamentos);
  • Apoiar o time na priorização do backlog e refinamento das histórias;
  • Atuar em cerimônias ágeis (Sprint Planning, Refinement, Review e Retrospective);
  • Apoiar testes funcionais e validação das entregas junto ao negócio.

Requisitos :

  • Experiência como Business Analyst em projetos Salesforce;
  • Conhecimento em Salesforce Service Cloud;
  • Experiência com Digital Engagement;
  • Experiência em escrita de requisitos funcionais e histórias de usuário;
  • Definição de critérios de aceite;
  • Conhecimento de modelagem de dados básica (objetos, campos e relacionamentos);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban).

Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Omni-Channel, filas, SLAs e roteamento;
  • Experiência em projetos de atendimento ao cliente ou contact center;
  • Certificações Salesforce (ex.: Salesforce Administrator ou Service Cloud Consultant);
  • Ingles Técnico: Desejável, mas não obrigatório.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

  • Elaborar requisitos funcionais, histórias de usuário e documentação funcional;
  • Definir critérios de aceite claros e testáveis;
  • Atuar na tradução das necessidades de negócio para soluções na plataforma Salesforce;
  • Participar da definição de soluções funcionais em Service Cloud;
  • Apoiar a implementação de Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp e Bots);
  • Definir e documentar regras de Omni-Channel Routing, filas, SLAs e roteamento;
  • Elaborar modelagem de dados funcional (objetos, campos e relacionamentos);
  • Apoiar o time na priorização do backlog e refinamento das histórias;
  • Atuar em cerimônias ágeis (Sprint Planning, Refinement, Review e Retrospective);
  • Apoiar testes funcionais e validação das entregas junto ao negócio.

Requisitos :

  • Experiência como Business Analyst em projetos Salesforce;
  • Conhecimento em Salesforce Service Cloud;
  • Experiência com Digital Engagement;
  • Experiência em escrita de requisitos funcionais e histórias de usuário;
  • Definição de critérios de aceite;
  • Conhecimento de modelagem de dados básica (objetos, campos e relacionamentos);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban).

Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Omni-Channel, filas, SLAs e roteamento;
  • Experiência em projetos de atendimento ao cliente ou contact center;
  • Certificações Salesforce (ex.: Salesforce Administrator ou Service Cloud Consultant);
  • Ingles Técnico: Desejável, mas não obrigatório.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.
